descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Lead coordination and discussion for making decision related to domain strategy, budgetary, solution, implementation plan under the domain
  • Lead coordination to build high level plan under the domain and lead development of more detailed plan
  • Review and monitor execution of the plan
  • Review and provide approval for solution and plan under the domain
  • Provide feedback to DH for architecture strategy, end to end architecture plan, budget planning, etc.

Job Description

Domain

  • Integration (ESB Middleware, RVS, Order FF, Product Catalog, API Management) solutioning

Strategic Planning

  • Translate the Company, Group, Division Vision, Mission, and Strategy into the domain work plan
  • Provide and clarify the domain objectives for the team
  • Establish the domain KPI based on organizational scorecard
  • Manage the domain’s budget based on work-plan and control the utilization/realization of it In order to ensure specific domain operates on budget and help contribute to organizational goals

Solution Development

  • DEFINE and PROVIDE Solution Architecture in COLLABORATION with Related Team.
  • DEVELOP effective and efficient solutions, which is represented by the value of proposed solutions in terms of investment and cost of resources required, of the requested use-cases from respective users within the expected time and the desired business outcomes. The solutions should incorporate end-to-end design impacts to system capacity, system features and capabilities, system performance and availability, system operation, business process, operational process, SLA, customer experience, and all IT Service Design aspects.
  • DEVELOP project timeline and resources plan to execute the solution development and deployment

System capacity management

  • EVALUATE system utilization based on periodic report from Operation Team.
  • TRANSLATE business requirement into system capacity requirement.
  • DEFINE capacity expansion plan according to capacity requirement.

System design and architecture improvement

  • EVALUATE current system design and architecture, aligned with Group reference architecture, and benchmark with best practice at the same industry.
  • DEVELOP the best practice design and architecture as a target reference architecture for Indosat
  • PLAN for design and architecture improvement towards efficient and effective and ready for digital experiences

System performance management

  • EVALUATE current system performance based on input from respective stakeholders including business and technology.
  • TRANSLATE business performance and customer experience into system and services performance SLA/KPI.
  • PLAN and DEVELOP program and initiatives for achieving target performance

Budgetary Plan and Sourcing Process

  • DEVELOP use-case of the proposed solution to represent the value of the proposed solution (investment, business outcomes, assumptions made, payback period)
  • INITIATING annual budgetary plan which includes new capabilities, capacity expansion, features enrichment and system transformation.
  • SUPPORT for budget approval process incorporation with another related team
  • SUPPORT for sourcing process including development related documentation (TOR, TE, and others)

Technology Strategy and Standardization

  • KEEP UP with global trends and technology update.
  • DEVELOP and MANAGE the technology plan and standards.
  • DEVELOP principles and selection method accordingly for the best and most suitable Partner and Technology.

Supporting Project Execution

  • SUPPORT project implementation
  • MONITOR project implementation


Education

Minimum bachelor’s degree (S1) in telecommunication / computer science / computer engineering, preferable Master Degree (S2) with major study in Informatics


Experiences

Has experience at minimum 8 years in telecommunication industry, especially in Integration (Middleware) technology design and solution.


Skills

General Skills:

  • Excellent communication in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.
  • Excellent technical writing and reporting.
  • Excellent presentation and persuasion skill capabilities.
  • Excellent knowledge of telecommunication business in general.
  • Excellent understanding in general and specific business process within the business users.
  • Excellent knowledge of IT system in detail and technology roadmap

Specific Skillset (Domain)

  • Has an excellent knowledge on Middleware: API Gateway, Enterprise Service Bus, Event Driven Architecture, Order Management (Boomi, Apigee, Tibco, Oracle, Apache Kafka, Confluent, MuleSoft Platform)
  • Has an excellent knowledge of Provisioning System, Order Capture Management and Product Catalog
  • Hands-on development skills across Middleware platforms (Boomi, Apigee, Tibco, Oracle, Apache Kafka, Confluent, MuleSoft Platform, Microservices with Containerization architecture)
  • Advanced Knowledge on some language programing such as Java, Erlang, etc.
  • 5+ Years’ Experience on middleware platform
  • Has experience and excellent knowledge on Modern Application Development Landscape: Container Centric, PaaS
  • Has experience and knowledge on Monolithic and Microservices Architecture to support system integration
  • Has good knowledge of Customer Apps, Customer Management and CRM
  • Has good knowledge on Digital Solution: API Monetization; IoT; Digital Customer Touch Point; Digital Marketing
  • Strong in Agile practice, service-oriented environment and better development practice.
  • Good knowledge of agile methodology and framework like Scrum, Kanban, XP, Crystal, FDD.
  • Good knowledge about Agile techniques like user stories, continuous integration, ATDD, TDD, continuous testing, pairing, automated testing, and Agile games.
  • Ability to take decision and commitment to deliver product on time.
  • Has a good knowledge on Business Support System for Telco Services
  • Has a good knowledge in ISS (Infrastructure) in the area of server, storage, database, container, cloud, & virtualization, backup system, desktop, local/wide area network, data center and disaster recovery.
  • Has a good knowledge in IT application and system design, database design and infrastructure design.
  • Has a good knowledge in Business Process Framework (eTOM), Application Framework (TAM) and Information Framework (SID), IT Service Management (ITIL).


Leadership Competencies

  • Work Standards
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Planning and Organizing
  • Business Awareness
  • Building Positive Working Relationships
  • Decision Making
  • Continuous Learning
  • Customer Excellence

Technical Competencies

  • AI / Advanced Analytics Enablement
  • Security Operations and Threat Management
  • Project, Program and Portfolio Delivery
  • DevOps, CI/CD and Automation
  • API and Integration Engineering
  • IT Governance, Risk and Compliance
  • Product Management and User Experience
  • Business and Technology Strategy
  • Software and Application Development
  • Cloud Architecture and Platform Engineering
  • Infrastructure Operations and Site Reliability
  • Cybersecurity Architecture and Governance


Specific Technical Competencies

  • Technical Competencies Telecommunications Business Strategy Planning & Roadmap Development Technical Specifications & Standardization IT Domain General Working Knowledge IT Infrastructure General Working Knowledge
  • API Gateway, Enterprise Service Bus, Event Driven Architecture , Order Management Provisioning System, Order Capture Management and Product Catalog Digital Solution: API Monetization; IoT; Digital Customer Touch Point; Digital Marketing Modern Application Development Landscape: Container Centric, PaaS Hands-on development skills across Middleware platform End to End Technical View Risk management


Behavioral Competencies

  • Effective Decision Making
  • Networking & influencing
  • Ownership, Drive & Engagement
  • Change Agility
  • Teamwork & collaboration
  • Effective Communication
  • Workplace Ethics
  • Customer Focus
  • Learning & growth Mindset

Re-Edit srl seleziona un Tecnico Service Desk da inserire nel team di Service Desk di I livello.

Non è richiesta alcuna esperienza lavorativa pregressa, ma è indispensabile aver già messo mano sui computer in modo pratico e reale.

Il candidato ideale sa utilizzare il PC in maniera avanzata; non è sufficiente saper usare il PC da “utente” ma serve averci lavorato sopra (installazioni, configurazioni, assistenza a familiari o piccoli uffici, attività svolte a scuola o durante corsi tecnici).

Attività Principali

  • Assistenza agli utenti su problemi base legati a PC, posta elettronica, account, password, stampanti, dispositivi mobili e sale riunioni

Competenze minime richieste (si deve trattare di esperienze reali, non solo teoriche):

Installazione di Windows

  • saper installare Windows 10/11 da USB o da rete
  • conoscere la scelta del disco, la formattazione e le partizioni
  • configurare una postazione post-installazione: driver, aggiornamenti, Office, antivirus
  • sapere distinguere tra Home/Pro e tra licenze OEM/retail

Gestione password e utenti

  • sapere cosa vuol dire resettare una password da pannello Microsoft 365
  • conoscere il concetto di dominio e utenza
  • aver utilizzato almeno una volta un pannello di amministrazione (anche quello base di Office 365)

Configurazione account e posta Outlook 365

  • aggiunta di un account Outlook su Windows
  • configurazione della posta aziendale (Exchange/Office 365) tramite autodiscover
  • riconoscere la differenza tra password del PC e password della posta
  • aver affrontato almeno una volta problemi di accesso, credenziali in cache, profili corrotti, file OST/PST

Supporto tecnico di base agli utenti

  • configurazione del computer per un utente
  • installare software e driver in modo corretto
  • installazione stampanti locali o di rete
  • configurazione Wi-Fi, rete cablata, VPN
  • riconoscere problemi comuni: mancanza IP, DNS non raggiungibile, cavo scollegato, ecc.
  • backup e restore dei dati

Competenze Gradite (non Obbligatorie)

  • conoscenze base di Android/iOS e configurazione email mobile
  • aver usato uno strumento di ticketing, anche in contesti didattici
  • minima esperienza su hardware (RAM, SSD, assemblaggi semplici)

Dettagli Del Ruolo

  • Sede di lavoro: Roma, in presenza
  • Orario di lavoro: Lunedì - Venerdì (09.00- 18:00)

Cosa Offriamo

  • affiancamento iniziale costante
  • formazione continua su procedure e strumenti aziendali
  • reale possibilità di crescita verso ruoli tecnici più avanzati (L2, TL)
  • ambiente professionale e strutturato, ideale per iniziare un percorso IT

"Il presente annuncio è rivolto a entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.”

descriptionHtml:
About EY:

EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in Consulting and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.

We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we work towards our ambition to be the best employer.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

We look forward you to joining us in the EYDS AI and Data team:

Ideally, you must have:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or above in Information Systems, Computer Science, Informatics, Electronics and Communications, or related disciplines.
  • Minimum 1-2 years (for Associate level) and 3-5 years (for Senior level) in data engineering.

Job description:

  • Design and implement scalable data pipelines to support data processing and analytics.
  • Conduct user acceptance test, user training.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes using Microsoft Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval processes for performance and efficiency

Technical skill:

  • Python/Scala for data processing, ETL, and automation
  • Data pipeline design and implementation
  • Data modelling
  • ETL development and maintenance
  • Data quality and integrity management
  • Optimizing data storage and retrieval
  • User acceptance testing (UAT) and training
  • Collaboration with data teams

Tools:

  • Azure Data Factory
  • Azure Databricks
  • Azure Cloud Platform
  • SQL-based databases

The opportunity:

You will help our clients navigate the business and technology transformation vision. We’ll look to you to provide our clients with a unique business and technology perspective on how technology can transform and improve their entire organization – starting with key business issues they face. This is a high-growth, high-visibility area with plenty of opportunities to enhance your skill set and build your career. 

Your key responsibilities:  

You’ll spend most of your time working with a wide variety of clients and your colleagues to deliver the latest trends, practices, technologies, and architecture to design, build and maintain scalable and robust solutions that unify, enrich, collaborate and deliver value.    

Skills and attributes for success:

  • Outstanding team player
  • High level of motivation
  • Strong work ethic
  • Self-starting attitude
  • Independent and able to manage and prioritize workload
  • Ability to quickly and positively adapt to change
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, client service, and technical writing skills, coupled with excellent executive presence.
  • Significant experience in managing and delivering medium to large teams on complex programs and projects.
  • Assessing, designing, architecting, and developing solutions leveraging the latest technologies and trends to exceed the business requirements
  • Unifying, enriching, and delivering value to derive insights and opportunities
  • Leveraging in-house and partners - platforms and solutions as needed and recommending and building new platforms/solutions as required to exceed business requirements
  • Communicating findings, recommendations, and opportunities to improve platforms and solutions
  • Demonstrating a deep understanding of technology, concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches
  • Seeking out information to learn about emerging methodologies and technologies
  • Clarifying problems by driving to understand the true issue
  • Looking for opportunities for improving methods and outcomes
  • Collaborating, influencing, and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
  • Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making 
  • Proven track record of sales and delivery in a consulting context with established client relationships and experience

What we look for: 

We’re interested in passionate individuals with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends. If you have a genuine passion for helping businesses achieve their full potential, then these role(s) are for you. 

What we offer:

  • Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
  • Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, on your way
  • Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Come join Karat's Interview Engineer Community!

Karat is always seeking talented engineers to join our Community. If you're interested in being considered for a future Interview Engineer opportunity, please submit your application to this posting. We'll keep your information on file and reach out when we're actively hiring in your area.

This is a contractor/freelancer opportunity, and work is compensated based on tasks performed. Currently, we are only accepting applications from candidates in the countries on our website; however, we anticipate near-future growth in additional locations and would love to contact you first when we expand!

Please note that all resumes must be submitted in English.

What Interview Engineers do:

Interview Engineers facilitate technical interviews with software developers around the world. As an Interview Engineer, you will create inclusive hiring processes by mitigating bias, improving hiring signals, and completing objective evaluations. These skills are critical to hiring and managing teams in startups and large enterprises. As a Karat Interview Engineer, you will:

  • Interview—Facilitate an interview through Karat's platform. Create an enjoyable candidate experience while you evaluate a candidate's fundamental coding skills and technical knowledge.
  • Evaluate—Provide input on the candidate's performance, coding style, communication skills, knowledge question answers, and coding approach.
  • Partner—Collaborate with Karat to test content, processes, and products.

The experience you will bring:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Software Developer or Software Engineer
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and oral) with a high level of professionalism and interpersonal skills
  • Reliable access to a working webcam, microphone, and a stable Internet connection
  • Experience conducting technical interviews is preferred (e.g., data structures, algorithms)

While we review your application and expand our community's global presence, learn more about life as an Interview Engineer by watching this video!

Additional Information

By applying for a position, you consent to the processing of your personal data in accordance with Karat's Employee and Contractor Privacy Notice found here.

About The University

Swansea University is a research-led university that has been making a difference since 1920. The University community thrives on exploration and discovery and offers the right balance of excellent teaching and research, matched by an enviable quality of life.

Our stunning waterfront campuses and multicultural community make us a desirable workplace for colleagues from around the world. Our reward and benefits, and ways of working enable those who join us to have enriching careers, matched by an excellent work-life balance.

About The Role

The Assistant Business Intelligence Analyst role is based within the Data, Information & Insight team and assists the delivery of strategic data analysis, data governance and business intelligence. Day to day responsibilities will primarily be manipulating and analysing datasets then building reports. The team uses a range of tools including Microsoft Fabric (Power BI), Savant, Alteryx and Excel.

The successful candidate will have an aptitude for working with data and have excellent communication skills and will work alongside an experienced team using industry standard business intelligence tools to produce impactful reporting and analysis solutions.

Contract: fixed term to 30 June 2026 (maternity cover)

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

The University is committed to supporting and promoting equality and diversity in all its practices and activities. We aim to establish an inclusive environment and welcome diverse applications from the following protected characteristics: age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic and national origin), religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation.

As an inclusive and welcoming workplace, we value people for their skills regardless of their background. Applications are welcome in Welsh and will not be treated less favourably than those submitted in English.

Welsh Language Skills

The Welsh language level required for this role is Level 1 - A little. The role holder will be able to pronounce Welsh words, answer the phone in Welsh (good morning/afternoon) and use very basic everyday words and phrases (thank you, please etc.). Level 1 can be reached by completing a 1 hour course.

The University is a proud bilingual institution, our Welsh Language Strategy outlines our aspiration to promote the language and enable our staff to engage with the language as an additional workplace skill and as a gateway to new cultural and social opportunities. Applications are welcome in Welsh and will not be treated less favourably than those submitted in English. Welsh speakers have the right to an interview in Welsh. Applicants for a role where Welsh skills are essential are expected to present their application in Welsh and will be interviewed in Welsh, if shortlisted.

Additional Information

Applications for this role will take the format of a CV submission and cover letter.

descriptionHtml:
About TCS:

A purpose-led organization that is building a meaningful future through innovation, technology, and collective knowledge. We're #BuildingOnBelief.


Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is a global leader in IT services, digital and business solutions that partners with its clients to simplify, strengthen and transform their businesses. TCS offers a consulting-led, integrated portfolio of IT, BPS, infrastructure, engineering and assurance services. We ensure the highest levels of certainty and satisfaction through a deep-set commitment to our clients, comprehensive industry expertise and a global network of innovation and delivery centers. For more information, visit us at www.tcs.com.


Role Summary

Own end-to-end delivery and ongoing support for iON SaaS product suites, acting as the single point of accountability between customer stakeholders and the iON Delivery teams. Drive flawless delivery through disciplined governance, proactive risk management, and customer adoption, while aligning with iON’s managed service and ITIL-based support processes.


Key Responsibilities:

Stakeholder, Requirements & Planning

  • Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders across business, IT, and leadership.
  • Lead customer workshops to elicit business processes, success metrics, and non‑functional needs; translate into clear, testable requirements.
  • Define scope, milestones, phases, deliverables, RACI, and team formation; establish baseline plans and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain a formal change‑control path (CRs), ensuring traceability from requirements to test cases and to release in Production.


Delivery Governance & Reporting

  • Run governance rhythms (weekly status, monthly steering, risk/issue reviews) with transparent RAID logs, executive summaries, and earned‑value style variance reporting.
  • Publish Weekly Status Reports and Monthly Governance Reports; track milestones and activities against plan, highlighting recovery actions where needed.
  • Ensure strict adherence to iON delivery processes and templates; champion “flawless delivery” behaviors across the team.


Technical Implementation (SaaS)

  • Orchestrate tenant/instance provisioning, environment readiness, configuration, and data migration runbooks; coordinate UAT cycles and sign‑offs.
  • Manage and monitor DC infrastructure setup in Indonesia.
  • Own go‑live readiness and hypercare (L1/L2/L3 triage, war room cadence, daily burn‑down of defects).
  • Align release planning with product roadmaps; communicate upgrade impacts and mitigation plans in advance.
  • Serve as the liaison between customers and iON Delivery teams in India for delivery and implementation activities.


Support, Operations & Customer Success

  • Stand up and optimize a ticketing process aligned to iON’s managed‑service model and ITIL incident/problem management; enforce SLAs and escalation paths.
  • Guide customer admin teams on “Report an Issue” workflows; ensure knowledge base, SOPs, and handbooks are current.
  • Monitor product usage and adoption; partner with business owners to improve onboarding, training, and change management outcomes.
  • Track invoices, collections, and payment milestones; surface commercial risks early and collaborate on resolution.


Risk, Compliance & Regional Coordination

  • Maintain a living risk register, dependency map, and mitigation plan.
  • Coordinate cross‑timezone work between Indonesia stakeholders and India‑based teams; manage privacy, terms of use, and approvals with local DPOs as required.
  • Ensure TCOC/TCS policies and customer’s data‑protection requirements are embedded into delivery practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 6–10 years in IT project management with 3+ years leading SaaS implementations end‑to‑end.
  • Exposure to education products, marketplaces (e.g. Ruangguru and likes), and Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Demonstrated delivery in multi‑party, offshore/onshore models; comfortable managing cross‑functional product, engineering, QA, service desk, and delivery assurance teams.
  • Certifications preferred: PMP/PRINCE2, CSM/ACP, ITIL Foundation.
  • Strong skills in requirements analysis, integration patterns, data migration, test planning, and release management.


Tools & Platforms

  • Project/Agile: Jira, MS Project.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Excel/PowerPoint), WSR/Governance decks.
  • Service Operations: Service Desk/ticketing aligned to ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change).




Thank you for your interest in applying for this position with TCS. All applicants who meet the requirements will be considered equally and fairly for employment. TCS is an equal employment opportunity provider and does not differentiate applicants on any basis. If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to apply for this career opportunity, Please do connect with us on our linked In TCS Asia Pacific Handle and we will be happy to guide you further.


We will review your application and will get back to you if we are considering your interest in this opportunity!

As a fraud analyst, the jobholder will be to conduct monitoring, investigation and detecting potential fraudulent activity in the bank's digital transactions. Your responsibilities will include reviewing customer transactions for any signs of suspicious behavior, identifying potential fraud trends, and investigating any incidents of fraud and this includes contacting the customers to conduct inquiries as necessary. You will also work closely with other teams, such as IT, Customer Service and Risk Management, to develop and implement fraud prevention strategies and policies. Additionally, you will need to keep up-to-date with the latest fraud detection technologies and tools and participate in regular training sessions and team meetings. Your efforts will be crucial in ensuring the safety and security of the bank's digital transactions and maintaining customer trust and confidence.

Major Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and investigating fraud alerts and customer reports to detect any signs of suspicious activity or behavior that may indicate potential fraud.
  • Analyzing transaction data and patterns to identify potential fraud trends and patterns.
  • Investigating incidents of suspected fraud, including gathering evidence and working with other teams to resolve cases.
  • Collaborating with other departments, such as IT, Customer Services and Risk Management, to develop and implement fraud prevention strategies and policies.
  • Staying up-to-date on the latest fraud detection technologies and tools and participating in regular training sessions and team meetings.
  • Maintaining accurate records of fraud incidents and investigations and providing regular reports to management.
  • Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements related to fraud prevention and reporting.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 2 years’ hands-on experience in a fraud investigation role in banking and Data Analytics.
  • Experience in digital banking and/or financial technology companies will be a significant plus.
  • Basic python programming is a plus.
  • Advance knowledge in SQL and basic statistical knowledge is a must
  • Strong analytical skills and put attention on details
  • Conversational ability in English is a must
  • Strong and highly motivated with positive mindset attitude
  • Collaborative and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

Responsibilities

A Business Analyst specializing in HIS (Health Information Systems), EMR (Electronic Medical Records), and ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) analyzes, documents, and translates business needs into technical solutions for healthcare and enterprise systems.   • Process Analysis:

  • Technical Specification:

  • System Implementation & Testing:

Collaborate with IT teams on the implementation and customization of HIS, EMR, and ERP systems and conduct thorough system testing.

  • User Support & Training:

Provide training, support, and documentation to end-users to ensure successful adoption and utilization of the systems.

  • Data Analysis & Reporting:

Analyze system data, create visualizations, and provide insights to support strategic decision-making.

Specific Focus Areas

  • HIS/EMR Focus:

Understand and document requirements for health information systems, focusing on clinical workflows, patient data management, regulatory compliance (like HIPAA), and user experience for healthcare providers.

  • ERP Focus:

Analyze and optimize core business processes (like finance, HR, supply chain) and align them with ERP system capabilities to improve efficiency and data integration across departments.

Project management and change management skills to support user adoption.ResponsibilitiesA Business Analyst specializing in HIS (Health Information Systems), EMR (Electronic Medical Records), and ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) analyzes, documents, and translates business needs into technical solutions for healthcare and enterprise systems. Key responsibilities include gathering and documenting user and system requirements, analyzing and optimizing workflows, translating these needs into technical specifications for IT implementation, and providing training and support to end-users.Core Responsibilities Requirement Gathering:Work with stakeholders to gather and document detailed business needs for HIS, EMR, and ERP systems. Process Analysis:Analyze existing business processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement and optimization. Technical Specification:Translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications for the IT department to implement in the systems. System Implementation & Testing:Collaborate with IT teams on the implementation and customization of HIS, EMR, and ERP systems and conduct thorough system testing. User Support & Training:Provide training, support, and documentation to end-users to ensure successful adoption and utilization of the systems. Data Analysis & Reporting:Analyze system data, create visualizations, and provide insights to support strategic decision-making.Specific Focus Areas HIS/EMR Focus:Understand and document requirements for health information systems, focusing on clinical workflows, patient data management, regulatory compliance (like HIPAA), and user experience for healthcare providers. ERP Focus:Analyze and optimize core business processes (like finance, HR, supply chain) and align them with ERP system capabilities to improve efficiency and data integration across departments.

Responsabilità e Attività Del Ruolo

Are you a dynamic individual that is passionate about driving business planning excellence and cross-functional collaboration? We are seeking a Business Planning Manager to join our team, where you will play a pivotal role in aligning strategy, forecasting, and commercial operations to achieve outstanding business results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Promotion Planning: Develop and manage promotion quantities and plans, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives.
  • Launch Planning: Collaborate with Marketing and other stakeholders to execute successful product launches, with accountability for launch pipe sizing and seamless cross-functional coordination.
  • Forecast Construction: Lead and embed robust business planning processes, guaranteeing a customer-centric and data-driven commercial forecast.
  • Risk & Opportunities Identification: Proactively identify strategic risks and opportunities, leveraging commercial forecasts to enrich the planning cycle and ensure consistency with business trends and gap analyses.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships across KAMs, Supply, Finance, and other teams to drive optimized sales planning and business alignment (The Way We Plan).
  • Forecast Accuracy: Ensure promo and unit forecasts are accurate and up-to-date, consolidating promo plans and supporting O+O commercial processes.
  • Customer Centricity: Serve as a critical stakeholder in delivering best-in-class forecast accuracy and bias reduction at the customer level.

YOU HAVE...

  • Min. 5 years of experience in business planning, RGM, commercial forecasting, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to anticipate risks and identify growth opportunities.
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional collaboration and alignment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Customer-centric mindset and a drive for continuous improvement.

YOU ARE...

  • Entrepreneurial. Every single day, you spot opportunities to shake things up and change the world for the better.
  • Adventurous. You'll embrace challenges and changes with fire in your belly and a great big smile on your face
  • Open. To new ways of doing things. To other people's (sometimes crazy) ideas.
  • Respectful. Whether you're talking to our internal or external stakeholders, consumers, you treat everyone the same
  • Ambitious. You crave for success and we'll support you all the way.
  • Only Human. You'll screw up sometimes but you have no fear of failure because you're smart enough to learn from mistakes.
  • You. You're real. And you're true to yourself. We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are

descriptionHtml:
Gear Inc is an American owned and operated business process outsourcing company operating in Southeast Asia. Matchbox Mobile - Gear Inc provides industry leading Image Moderation, Social Media Management, IT Consulting, Application Development, Game Development, and Outsourcing Services. We are experts in moderating online user generated content.

An IT Technician in a BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) environment is responsible for providing technical support and ensuring the smooth operation of IT systems, networks, and hardware that support the business operations. The role requires maintaining the IT infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, implementing security protocols, and ensuring minimal downtime for IT systems. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and the ability to handle IT tasks in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

For more information, please visit our websites: https://www.gearinc.com/ and https://puremoderation.com/

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support:
    • Provide on-site and remote technical support to end-users, including diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues.
    • Assist with troubleshooting desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral issues.
    • Handle IT service requests and incidents, ensuring timely resolution within Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • System Maintenance and Monitoring:
    • Perform regular maintenance, updates, and patching of operating systems, software applications, and security tools.
    • Monitor system and network performance, proactively addressing potential issues to minimize downtime.
    • Ensure uptime for essential business systems, including VoIP, monitoring systems.
  • Network and Infrastructure Management:
    • Assist in the configuration and maintenance of LAN/WAN networks, routers, switches, and firewalls.
    • Set up and maintain VPNs and remote access configurations to support BPO operations.
    • Perform routine network checks to ensure connectivity and proper configuration.
  • Security and Compliance:
    • Implement and monitor cybersecurity measures, such as firewalls, antivirus software, and data encryption.
    • Follow organizational security protocols and industry compliance standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA) to protect sensitive customer data.
    • Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and risk assessments to identify and resolve security threats.
  • IT Asset Management:
    • Manage the inventory of hardware, software, and other IT assets, ensuring proper documentation, tracking, and disposal.
    • Assist in the setup and deployment of workstations, including installing necessary software and configuring systems.
    • Ensure that IT hardware (laptops, desktops, servers) is functioning optimally and address issues such as hardware malfunctions or replacements.
  • Support for BPO Operations:
    • Provide technical support for specialized software and tools used in BPO operations.
  • Documentation and Reporting:
    • Maintain accurate documentation of technical procedures, configurations, and solutions in the knowledge base for future reference.
    • Provide regular reports on system performance, incidents, and resolutions to management.
    • Assist in the development and implementation of IT policies and procedures.


Key Skills And Experience

  • Holds a diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Possesses relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, MCP, or CCNA (preferred).
  • Has 2-3 years of experience as an IT Technician in a BPO, contact center, or fast-paced corporate environment.
  • Demonstrates strong knowledge of Windows, Mac, and Linux operating systems.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting network, hardware, and software issues efficiently.
  • Familiar with VoIP, CRM, and workforce management systems commonly used in BPO settings.
  • Experienced in managing network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, VPNs, firewalls, and switches.
  • Able to diagnose and resolve technical issues quickly and effectively under pressure.
  • Proactive in identifying and preventing potential system problems.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally with end-users, management, and technical teams.
  • Capable of explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in an easy-to-understand manner.
  • Works effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Manages multiple tasks and deadlines efficiently in a dynamic work environment.
  • Demonstrates strong customer service orientation with a focus on minimizing operational disruptions.
  • Maintains a positive, can-do attitude when assisting staff with technical issues.


Benefit:

  • Attractive basic salary
  • Allowance (attendance, transportation, overtime, and public holiday)
  • Mental Health Care service (on site Psychologist and mental health application)
  • BPJS Kesehatan
  • BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Monthly internal events
  • Paid leave
  • Career path


Working Environment

  • International, fun, and professional working environment:
  • Working closely with experienced foreign experts;
  • Free drinks (coffee, mineral water, etc.)
  • Training and career development opportunities;
  • Sport activities and game room.


Working Location: Imam Bonjol No 502, West Denpasar, Bali

descriptionHtml:
Esco Lifesciences Group is a world-leading manufacturer of laboratory, pharmaceutical equipment, bioprocess tools and IVF medical devices, delivering sustainable workflow solutions to advance global health. Since 1978, the Singapore-based company is committed to excellence, ensuring forward-thinking technology, responsive support, and reliability, making Esco a trusted partner for the life science and medical markets in more than 150 countries.


We are looking for a proactive and analytical Business Analyst to join our Business Process Improvement team. This role plays a key part in identifying operational inefficiencies and driving change across the organization. You will work closely with the Project Management Office (PMO), Software Development Team, IT, Operations, and External Consultants to design, implement, and roll out improved business processes and systems.

As a change facilitator, you will be responsible not only for identifying improvement opportunities but also for driving adoption and behavioral change across teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze current business processes, identify pain points, and recommend improvements.
  • Design and document optimized workflows and operational processes that are scalable and efficient.
  • Translate business needs into detailed business and functional requirements.
  • Collaborate with the PMO, IT, Operations, and Development teams throughout the entire project lifecycle.
  • Act as a change agent to support rollouts, training, and smooth adoption of new processes/systems.
  • Coordinate implementation efforts, working with cross-functional teams and external consultants.
  • Measure and track the effectiveness of improvements post-implementation.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Amount of accumulated time savings per year through streamlined processes
  • Successful implementation and adoption of new workflows/systems
  • Reduction in turnaround time and manual tasks
  • Accuracy and completeness of business requirement documentation
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement


Requirements:

  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience as a Business Analyst or similar role in process improvement and/or system implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience working with PMO, IT, Operations, and Development teams.
  • Strong proficiency in business process analysis, workflow design, and requirement documentation.
  • Proven ability to lead and facilitate change management and cross-team coordination.
  • Experienced with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Good to have:

  • Experience using process modeling tools (e.g., Visio)
  • Exposure to ERP, CRM, OA or workflow automation systems
  • Prior experience working in a manufacturing company

Overview

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and optimal performance of electrical equipment within the production and packaging areas. This role leads the execution of Preventive Maintenance (PM) activities based on established quality standards and work orders, while also responding promptly to equipment failures to minimize downtime and support continuous operations.

Key duties include completing inspection checklists and job logs to identify potential risks, escalating serious incidents as required by maintenance procedures, and performing Corrective Maintenance (CM) with a focus on reducing MTTR during production shifts. The role is also accountable for adhering to and enforcing compliance with GMP, AIB, and Occupational Safety standards for both internal and contractor personnel working with electrical systems.

Responsibilities

What you are responsible for:

  • Ensure execution of the Preventive Maintenance (PM) program for electrical equipment in the production and packaging areas to meet quality standards and repair requirements (WO)
  • Execute timely solutions for defects to manager, do 100% of job listings (checklist), job log (log sheet) in the managed area to identify potential risks (if any), and reports.
  • Notify serious incidents according to maintenance procedures.
  • Execute the implementation of electrical PM tasks and handle incidents during production shifts
  • Ensure rapid execution of the Corrective Maintenance (CM) for electrical equipment in the production and packaging areas to reduce MTTR on production shift
  • Implement and execute compliance with GMP, AIB, Occupational Safety regulations by permanent employees and contractor employees related to assigned electrical equipment.

Qualifications

What you will need to have:

  • Minimum D3 education degree in a relevant education major
  • 2-4 years of experience in Electrical Engineering role
  • Experience in a FMCG manufacturing role is preferred
  • Verbal and Written communication in both Bahasa and English will be preferred

About EY:

EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in Consulting and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.

We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

We look forward you to joining us in the Cybersecurity Junior Consultant team with below roles:

  • Cyber Engineer – Red Team and Blue Team
  • Cyber Engineer – Managed Services
  • Cyber Threat Modelling
  • Managed Services
  • Identity Management

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or above in Information Systems, Computer Science, Electronics and Communications, or related disciplines.
  • Fresh graduates or min. 1-2 years experienced in Cybersecurity roles.

The opportunity:

You will help our clients navigate the business and technology transformation vision. We’ll look to you to provide our clients with a unique business and technology perspective on how technology can transform and improve their entire organization – starting with key business issues they face. This is a high-growth, high-visibility area with plenty of opportunities to enhance your skill set and build your career. 

Your key responsibilities:  

You’ll spend most of your time working with a wide variety of clients and your colleagues to deliver the latest trends, practices, technologies, and architecture to design, build and maintain scalable and robust solutions that unify, enrich, collaborate and deliver value.    

Skills and attributes for success:

  • Outstanding team player
  • High level of motivation
  • Strong work ethic
  • Self-starting attitude
  • Independent and able to manage and prioritize workload
  • Ability to quickly and positively adapt to change
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, client service, and technical writing skills, coupled with excellent executive presence.
  • Significant experience in managing and delivering medium to large teams on complex programs and projects.
  • Assessing, designing, architecting, and developing solutions leveraging the latest technologies and trends to exceed the business requirements
  • Unifying, enriching, and delivering value to derive insights and opportunities
  • Leveraging in-house and partners - platforms and solutions as needed and recommending and building new platforms/solutions as required to exceed business requirements
  • Communicating findings, recommendations, and opportunities to improve platforms and solutions
  • Demonstrating a deep understanding of technology, concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches
  • Seeking out information to learn about emerging methodologies and technologies
  • Clarifying problems by driving to understand the true issue
  • Looking for opportunities for improving methods and outcomes
  • Collaborating, influencing, and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
  • Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making 
  • Proven track record of sales and delivery in a consulting context with established client relationships and experience

What We Offer

  • Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
  • Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, on your way
  • Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

About Us

At Axross, we build advanced AI-powered HVAC solutions to optimize energy efficiency in

industries such as pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and precision manufacturing. Our

cutting-edge systems help manufacturers better control their production environments while

reducing energy consumption, leading to significant cost reductions and supporting

environmental sustainability.

Role Overview

As an IoT Engineer, you will play a vital role in deploying and maintaining our AI-driven HVAC

solutions onsite. Your responsibilities will include ensuring that our equipment is properly

installed, well-maintained, and functioning effectively. You will address client concerns, perform

onsite repairs, and coordinate closely with our software and technical teams to ensure seamless

integration of hardware and software.

This role also involves testing and validating our in-house apps and software to ensure optimal

performance. We are looking for a Junior IoT Engineer who is passionate about IoT technology,

enjoys problem-solving, and thrives in a collaborative environment. Your work will contribute

directly to creating sustainable solutions that enhance system performance, improve energy

efficiency, and deliver value to our clients.

\ Key Responsibilities:

  • IoT System Development:

○ Design, develop, and test IoT applications for connected HVAC systems.

○ Write and maintain software in Python, C, or C++ for IoT devices and edge

computing.

  • Device Integration:

○ Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and other

peripherals into IoT systems.

○ Address operating system-level tasks, including driver/kernel development and

hardware-software interfacing.

  • Communication Protocols:

○ Implement and optimize IoT communication protocols like MQTT, HTTP, and

CoAP.

○ Ensure secure and efficient data transmission between IoT devices and cloud or

on-premises systems.

  • System Monitoring & Troubleshooting:

○ Debug and resolve hardware and software issues, including network

communication problems and memory leaks.

○ Monitor and maintain IoT systems to ensure high availability and scalability.

  • Collaboration & Documentation:

○ Work closely with software developers, hardware engineers, and AI specialists

to develop integrated solutions.

○ Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for IoT systems, protocols,

and configurations.

\ Requirements:

  • Education:

○ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Technical Skills:

○ Proficiency in programming languages like Python, C, C++.

○ Familiarity with IoT communication protocols (e.g., MQTT, HTTP, BLE) and cloud

platforms (e.g., AWS IoT, Azure IoT).

○ Experience with Linux systems, Docker, and embedded programming.

○ Understanding of networking concepts (TCP/UDP) and debugging tools (e.g.,

GDB, tcpdump, valgrind).

  • Problem-Solving:

○ Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve IoT system

issues.

  • Soft Skills:

○ Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a

collaborative, dynamic environment.

○ Eagerness to learn and stay updated on new IoT technologies and industry

trends.

Preferred Attributes

  • Hands-on experience with industrial hardware and IoT security best practices.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, data management, and cybersecurity in IoT systems.
  • Exposure to cloud platform integrations and scalable IoT solution design.
  • Opportunities to work on impactful AI-driven IoT projects in a cutting-edge industry.
  • Mentorship and career growth in IoT development and integration.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with exposure to high-profile clients.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and professional development opportunities.\ \ What We Offer:
  • Opportunities to work on impactful AI-driven IoT projects in a cutting-edge industry.
  • Mentorship and career growth in IoT development and integration.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with exposure to high-profile clients.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and professional development opportunities.

descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

This position is responsible for establishing, implementing, and managing the hospital’s information technology systems from the commissioning stage through ongoing operations. This position oversees the planning, installation, testing, and integration of IT infrastructure, ensuring that all technology systems are fully functional and aligned with the hospital’s, clinical, administrative, and operational needs.

During the commissioning phase, this position works closely with project teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure timely setup of hospital information systems, network infrastructure, data centers, and communication systems. Once operational, the role transitions to maintaining system reliability, security, and efficiency while leading the IT team in delivering responsive technical support and continuous improvement.

Key Outcomes

  • Successful commissioning and deployment of all hospital IT systems within projects timelines and quality standards
  • Seamless integration of clinical and non-clinical information systems to support patient care and hospital operations
  • Reliable, secure, and compliant IT environments in accordance with health data protection standards
  • Efficient day-to-day IT operations with minimal system downtime
  • Competent and responsive IT team supporting hospital – wide technology needs

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

During the Commissioning phase

  • Participate in the planning and design of IT infrastructure, ensuring alignment with hospital requirement and best practices
  • Coordinate installation and configuration of network systems, servers, hospital information systems (HIS), EMR/HER, communications systems and other technology platforms
  • Collaborate with vendors, contractors, and consultants to ensure timely delivery and integration of IT systems
  • Conduct system testing, validation, and commissioning to ensure readiness for hospital operations
  • Develop IT operational manuals, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and system documentation
  • Support staff training on hospital IT systems prior to hospital opening

Post-commissioning/operational phase:

  • Supervise and coordinate the IT unit’s daily operations
  • Ensure system reliability, cyber security, and data integrity across all hospital systems
  • Oversee preventive maintenance, backups, and disaster recovery plans
  • Manage helpdesk support and resolve technical issues promptly
  • Maintain accurate IT asset inventory and manage procurement of IT equipment and licenses
  • Monitor performance of hospital systems and recommend improvements or upgrades
  • Ensure compliance with hospital policies, data privacy, and healthcare IT standards
  • Lead, train, and evaluate IT staff to ensure high performance and professional growth
  • Collaborate with hospital management and clinical teams to align IT strategies with organizational goals
  • Manage IT budgets and vendor relationship effectively

Selection Criteria

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, computer science, or related field
  • Min 3 years of relevant experience in healthcare, hospital, or large-scale infrastructure projects
  • Proven experience in hospital commissioning or healthcare IT system setup is highly desirable
  • Strong knowledge in hospital IT systems and network infrastructure
  • Proficient in system integration, network administration, and cybersecurity practices
  • Knowledge of healthcare data protection, regulatory compliance, and IT governance standards
  • Excellent project coordination, troubleshooting, and problem solving skills

About Us

We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.

The IT Onsite Support Internship is responsible for supporting the IT team in day-to-day technical assistance to users, ensuring that computers, networks, and IT equipment operate smoothly. This role involves troubleshooting hardware and software issues, installing and maintaining devices, and coordinating with central IT teams for system updates or escalated support. The position requires hands-on work at the site, strong problem-solving skills, and good communication to support employees effectively.

  • Keep records of support activities and equipment.
  • Support meeting room equipment and video conferencing tools.
  • Ensure IT equipment and systems run smoothly and securely.
  • Give basic IT guidance or training to users when needed.

  • Able to diagnose and fix hardware or software issues.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Organized, responsible, and service oriented.
  • Basic IT certifications (like CompTIA A+ or Microsoft) are a plus.
  • Local candidates from Duri or Riau area will be prioritized.

Please note: Due to the massive number of applicants, only selected candidates will be notified.

descriptionHtml:
As a Regional IT Engineer, you will be the onsite technical expert supporting our regional offices and collaborating closely with Group IT. Your role ensures the reliability, security, and performance of IT systems while driving strategic initiatives such as cloud adoption, ISO 27001 compliance, and M&A integrations.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-User Support: Deliver Level 2 support for hardware, software, and network issues to maintain business continuity.
  • Security & Compliance: Monitor and enforce security standards aligned with ISO 27001 and group policies.
  • Cloud & Identity Management: Administer Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, and Exchange Online.
  • Endpoint & Device Management: Configure and manage Intune, Autopilot, and endpoint security tools (Defender, Sentinel One, CrowdStrike).
  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain local servers, networks (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi), VPN (SonicWall), and Hyper-V environments.
  • Access Control: Manage application access and ensure compliance with security requirements.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain IT asset records, SOPs, and deliver user training.
  • Project Participation: Support M&A IT integrations, office relocations, and new technology deployments.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years in IT support (Level 2 or onsite).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Azure AD, and Exchange Online.
  • Experience with endpoint management (Intune, Endpoint Central) and automated software distribution.
  • Proficiency in Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2016/2019, and Hyper-V.
  • Networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, Wi-Fi (Aruba/Ruckus).
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira, ManageEngine).
  • Exposure to ISO 27001 audits/compliance.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience in hybrid or multi-site environments.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and vulnerability management.
  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell).
  • Familiarity with ITIL 4 principles.


Certifications (Preferred)

  • ITIL 4 Foundation
  • Microsoft 365 Administrator / Modern Desktop Administrator
  • Azure or AWS Cloud Administration
  • CompTIA A+ or Cybersecurity certifications (ISACA, SANS, EC-Council)


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to support a global organization with growth potential.
  • Access to training and professional development.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture.

Job Title : Avionics AME Lead

Position Type : Permanent Full Time

Location : 13-475 Airport Road, Sault Ste. Marie Airport

Posting Expires : When suitable candidates are selected

Job Purpose

Our continuous growth creates a demand for heavy maintenance leads. We service the Dash 8 Q400, Dash 8 100/300 aircrafts, along with, the CRJ100/200/700/900 aircrafts, Boeing 737 (all series) and Embraer E170/175 aircraft.

We expect applicants to be ready to work in a fast-paced work environment. Our role requires individuals to have excellent communication skills with a team player attitude!

Job Description

Reporting to the Production Managers, the AME Avionics Lead is responsible for providing mentorship and guidance to the team responsible for servicing, repair and certification of aircraft electrical and electronic systems in accordance with the policy and procedures defined in both the JD Aero Maintenance Policy Manual (MPM), the applicable Regulations.

Responsibilities And Competencies

  • Actively participate in the JD Aero Safety Management System and Quality Assurance programs
  • Lead and mentor junior team members, including planning and organizing works tasks
  • Review work scope, estimate materials and labour, submit requests for materials to stores
  • Perform all avionics maintenance on aircraft pitot static, communication, navigation, autopilot, flight director, flight management, and ELT in accordance with Transport Canada Regulations and Standards
  • Perform modifications to previously mentioned avionic systems in accordance with manufacturers service bulletins, engineering instructions, airworthiness directives or Transport Canada approved supplementary type certifications
  • Ensure the proper certification of all components installed on aircraft
  • Ensure timely and accurate Technical Record entries are completed as required
  • Identify defects and ensure Service Difficulty Reports are submitted for avionics in accordance with the regulatory requirements
  • Ensure all applicable equipment is properly maintained and facilities are clean, safe and appropriately equipped
  • Provide mentorship and supervision of non-licensed personnel ensuring that critical knowledge and workmanship is transferred to them
  • Lead by example and be a positive role model for others to follow
  • Perform other related activities, as necessary or as assigned by management
  • Respect and uphold all the Company policies, procedures & performance expectations Communicate any discrepancies, process gaps or noticeable trends to Executive Management
  • Adhere to and participate in the Company SMS program
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Department
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Valid Transport Canada Aircraft Maintenance Engineer ‘E’ License required
  • Post-Secondary education in recognized Aircraft Maintenance/Avionics Engineer Program
  • Minimum three (3) years of experience working as an Aircraft Maintenance Engineer in Avionics
  • Previous experience as a team lead or supervisor considered an asset
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel) and familiarity with ERP systems
  • Positive ‘can-do’ attitude as well as proven expertise in performing Avionics maintenance and repairs in accordance with their training, regulatory requirements and company procedures.
  • Knowledge of avionics materials and parts and a strong understanding of the regulations governing their acceptance for certified aircraft and the process of quarantine action.
  • Proven success in performing under pressure and the ability to multitask while paying close attention to details and the surrounding environment
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written to ensure safe and compliant outcomes
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to perform physical tasks, including lifting and moving items weighing up to 50 pounds

Why JD Aero Technical

JD Aero Technical was established in 2007, and we are in our sixteenth year of operation as the chosen heavy maintenance provider for several of North America’s regional aircraft operators. We are looking to add to our group of over 100 employees who have all worked hard to build our diversified and experienced workforce. We offer competitive wages with good opportunities for overtime while maintaining a healthy work life balance.

Successful candidates will receive a competitive salary. Based on your commitment and dedication, there is an opportunity for training and room to grow.

Typical Benefits Include

  • Competitive Wages
  • Life Insurance
  • Extended Health & Dental Care
  • Health & Wellness Benefits
  • Paid vacation in accordance with Federal Government Requirements

Working Hours

Working hours are mainly 7:00 am to 3:30 pm and 8:00 am to 4:30 pm, Monday to Friday, with rotating weekend shifts. Extra hours may be required to support operations at critical times.

How To Apply

If you are interested in this job opportunity and possess the required qualifications, please email your resume and references to careers@jdaeromaintenance.coms

We appreciate all interested applications; however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please quote the job title you are applying for in the email subject line.

About Us

We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.

Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe.

Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.

Job Description

The Wireline Field Specialist ensures safe, efficient, and reliable wireline service delivery at well sites. This role combines technical expertise, operational execution, and supervisory responsibilities to guarantee service delivery and compliance with SLB and industry standards.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Prepare and verify wireline tools and surface systems (logging unit, computers, sensors, hand tools, etc.).
  • Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation plans, ensure compliance with HSE and service quality standards.
  • Having basic knowledge of wireline control system, PCE (pressure control equipment), electronic-mechanical assemblies.
  • Perform rig-up and rig-down of equipment according to company procedures.
  • Execute cased-hole perforation using explosive charges and gun systems.
  • Conduct plug setting, fishing, and mechanical intervention operations.
  • Supervise cable handling and ensure proper explosive safety protocols.
  • Secure and demobilize equipment; prepare job reports and participate in service quality reviews.
  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, and SLB teams; provide technical support and mentor junior staff.
  • Provide input to management and peers to develop & maintain an effective and efficient teamwork within personnel and segment.
  • Participate in HSE and Quality programs.

Qualifications And Experience

  • Diploma or Bachelor degree in Engineering.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in wireline operations offshore and onshore.
  • Ability to work under pressure, travel frequently, and adapt to 24/7 operational demands.
  • Comfortable working in remote and challenging environments.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills.
  • Ability to writing and speaking in Indonesian and English effectively with managers, peers and clients both written and verbally.
  • Indonesian nationality

descriptionHtml:
About the company

StaffAny’s mission is to shape and empower the future of work. We provide our users with a remedy that streamlines and automates their painful Operations and HR processes. Our users rely on our superpowers to understand their frustrations and we are here to empower them to make time for what they love. 


About the role

As a Product Designer, you will help define our products and features from start to end, improving the user experience and driving business outcomes like customer acquisition and retention. You will be working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional pod working with product managers and engineers to ensure that we build the right products, and also build our products right.


You’ll have the opportunity to own smaller features end to end, and contribute to larger or more complex initiatives. You’ll be expected to

  • Lead discovery with customers and identity customer pain points or validate solutions
  • Understand complex systems / requirements / logic / edge cases and map flows across multiple states
  • Produce polished production ready UI in Figma with component consistency based on internal design systems
  • Support launches for projects from other people / teams
  • And all these efforts could span across all the markets and product lines we serve


You might be aspiring to eventually become a senior product designer, who can represent your problem area and product line as a thought leader, and the breadth and depth of exposure to new problem areas, and work in this stint would put you in a good position to do so.


With your success, over the next few years you will have taken StaffAny from a workforce management tool to our envisioned operating system for hourly work.


As a Product Designer, you are / have
  • You have 1–3 years of product design experience
  • Strong english communication skills (both written and spoken)
  • A passion for design and usability
  • Experience collaborating with product managers and engineers to ship projects
  • Your portfolio should include at least one example of a shipped, complex web app / app (not just landing pages or conceptual redesigns)
  • Highly independent and pragmatic, and have a strong bias for action
  • Embrace a growth mindset
  • Bonus if you have background in SaaS or HRIS products
  • Bonus if you have built / maintained a design system before
  • Bonus if you are based in KL and willing to travel to customers to meet them
  • Bonus if you’re from a technical background
  • Bonus if you speak chinese can can help with user interviews or copy translation in the app
  • Bonus if you have incorporated AI prototyping tools into your workflow before


You will find yourself
  • Anchoring design projects end to end, ranging from research, conceptual design, prototypes, validation of usability and feasibility to creating production ready designs and implementation
  • Articulating design decisions, leveraging experience, research, and data to build consensus and move the product process forward, and incorporating feedback into the design lifecycle
  • Creating durable, reusable components and patterns to accelerate the design process and create consistent, coherent experiences for users.
  • Working alongside engineers and other designers to ensure design quality in implementation and process improvements
  • Supporting design initiatives by sharing your process and knowledge and bringing our processes inside the team to the next level


Potential Performance Indicators
  • Adoption and retention of designed features


The offer
  • The opportunity to be at the front seat driving StaffAny’s vision of creating the operating system for hourly work
  • Be part of a fast-paced growth environment that always stretches you and forces you to be slightly uncomfortable
  • Work with talented, intense, and motivated colleagues in a dynamic and vibrant environment

descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading

digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in

Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we

managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine

customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and

flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better

financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company

with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the

bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank)

in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the

country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform,

Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who

‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time

of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

More About The Bank With Startup Culture Environment

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have

fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow

outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to

work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold

the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.

Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise

Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it,

have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our

journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-quality native Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack libraries
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure technical feasibility and a smooth user experience
  • Integrate with backend services and APIs efficiently and securely
  • Ensure application performance, responsiveness, and stability across devices and OS versions
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with attention to scalability and reliability
  • Identify and fix bugs, optimize performance, and improve application architecture
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Android technologies and development trends


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 3 - 4 years of experience in Android Kotlin development
  • Strong understanding of Android SDK, Jetpack Components, MVVM architecture
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, Retrofit, and dependency injection
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD processes
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in modular app architecture or multi-module projects is a plus


Bonus Point If

  • Speaking English fluently
  • Contributions to open-source projects (A link to GitHub profile)
  • Experienced in domain-driven or high-volume transaction development
  • Have knowledge and experience in mobile iOS development


We exist to innovate and maintain the architecture of Amar Bank's products. As part of our main focus to create through technology we ensure the process and technology we use helps maintain and build human connection at scale.

It’s our job to plan, monitor, and control the technology growth so we can provide a faster, more convenient, and more efficient way of performing business transactions.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Head of IT to lead and oversee the entire IT Department. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of IT operations, including infrastructure, systems, servers, security, internal applications, and IT support services.
