Job Purpose

Our continuous growth creates a demand for heavy maintenance lines. We service Dash 8 Q400, Dash 8 100/300, CRJ100/200/700/900 aircraft and have recently been granted approval for Boeing 737 (all series) and Embraer E170/175 aircraft.

You can expect to work in a fast-paced work environment with rotating shifts including afternoons and weekends. You must have excellent communication skills with a team player attitude.

Job Description

As an Aircraft Maintenance Engineer, under the supervision of the Production Manager, you will carry out maintenance tasks and provide mentorship to apprentices.

Aircraft Maintenance is a challenging and exciting career – fast, intense, dead-line driven and very high tech.

Responsibilities And Competencies

  • Carry out various maintenance tasks in accordance with the manufacturer’s manuals
  • Troubleshooting
  • Request parts and materials using the manufacturer’s manuals
  • Complete maintenance releases for work performed and ensure clear and accurate documentation
  • Mentor apprentices and trainees in best practices
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures
  • Participate in company SMS and report all hazards or incidents in accordance with company reporting procedures
  • Ensure a clean work area exercise FOD vigilance

Qualifications

  • Transport Canada AME License in the M Category, with previous experience on Dash-8 Q400, Classic Dash 8, or CRJ100/200/700/900 aircraft, for Boeing 737 (all series) and Embraer E170/175 aircraft (preferred)
  • Must be able to work with minimum supervision.
  • Good Understanding of the English Language with the ability to read, understand and follow instructions contained within Aircraft Manuals and Publications as it relates to Aircraft Maintenance.
  • Must possess excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Must have excellent mechanical aptitude and mechanical experience.
  • Must be able to obtain an Airport Restricted Area Pass.
  • Must have a clean criminal background.

Why JD Aero Technical

JD Aero Technical was established in 2007 and we are in our sixteenth year of operation as the chosen heavy maintenance provider for several of North Americas Q400 operators. We are looking to add to our group of over 120 employees who have all worked hard to build our diversified and experienced workforce. We offer competitive wages with good opportunities for overtime while maintaining a healthy work life balance.

Successful candidates will receive a competitive salary. Based on your commitment and dedication, there is the opportunity for training and room to grow to Senior and Shift Lead roles.

Typical Benefits Include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Life Insurance
  • Extended Health & Dental Care
  • Health & Wellness Benefits
  • Paid vacation (2 weeks or 4%; after 5 years, 3 weeks or 6%) in accordance with federal government requirements
  • The opportunity to bank overtime up to 1 week additional time off
  • Employee/family assistance program
  • Uniforms provided

Working Hours

Working hours are mainly 7:00am to 5:30pm, overtime may be offered to complete project deadlines.

How To Apply

If you are interested in this job opportunity and possess the required qualifications, please send a copy of your cover letter and resume with references via email to: careers@jdaeromaintenance.com

We appreciate all interested applications; however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please quote the job title you are applying for in the email subject line.

descriptionHtml:
MAKE HISTORY WITH US!

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business, and building our future on smoke-free products with the power to improve the lives of a billion smokers worldwide.

With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a curious, technically skilled individual with strong analytical abilities and excellent communication skills to join our team as a People Analytics Analyst. In this role, you will analyze workforce data to uncover insights that shape talent strategies and drive business performance. You’ll apply scientific thinking to business questions, using both statistical and qualitative methods, and collaborate closely with data science teams.

A key part of your role will be translating complex technical analyses into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with business stakeholders. You will transform data into actionable recommendations, enabling leaders to make informed, strategic decisions.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of data, people, and strategy—helping leaders make informed decisions that impact our global workforce.

Your 'day-to-day'

  • Lead end-to-end scaleable workforce analytics projects, from consulting with HR and business leaders to understand their needs, gathering business requirements, framing analytics questions, and validating hypothesis to delivering outputs, visualizing data, and generating actionable insights that drive value.
  • Partner with HR and business stakeholders to co-develop data-driven solutions and influence strategic decision-making.
  • In collaboration with data science teams, use data mining and statistical techniques to analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Translate complex data into clear, compelling stories and visualizations.
  • Provide data driven insights and recommendations that support talent strategies and business goals to drive actions
  • Measure Impacts from actions delivered
  • Continuously explore new tools, techniques, and data sources to enhance the impact and efficiency of analytics solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, privacy, and compliance in all analyses.
  • Support data literacy by sharing knowledge and best practices with HR colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Part of your role and onboarding journey will be to deliver operational reporting to ensure all reports are delivered according to SLA and support efforts to automate this demand

Who We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Psychology, Economics, Business, or related disciplines).
  • Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in HR or workforce-related domains.
  • Familiarity with HR systems and data (e.g. SuccessFactors).
  • Strong technical skills: advanced Excel, SQL, scripting (e.g. Python)
  • Strong statistical and quantitative analytical skills
  • Experience with dashboarding tools (e.g., Power BI, advanced PowerPoint storytelling).
  • Ability to apply structured thinking and scientific methods to problems.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills—able to translate data into business-relevant insights.
  • Strong consulting mindset: proactive, curious, and solution-oriented.
  • Understanding of data privacy and governance in HR analytics.

Join Hostinger, and we’ll grow fast! 🚀

We’re shaping the future of online success - powered by AI and driven by people. With 900+ talented professionals and over 4 million clients in 150 countries, we help creators and entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life faster and easier than ever before.

Our mission: To provide tools that help individuals and small businesses succeed online faster and easier.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Our formula for success: Customer obsession, innovative products, and talented teams.

Your role at Hostinger

Workspace specialist in the Business Operatios team. As part of Hostinger's IT Operations team, you'll be responsible for preparing and maintaining employee laptops, managing SaaS tools and system access, resolving technical issues, and ensuring a secure and efficient IT environment. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with other teams to deliver seamless onboarding experiences, maintain reliable infrastructure, and support smooth daily operations across the company.

Curious to learn more? Connect with your team: Ervinas Langis, IT Workplace Manager

Your day-to-day


  • Prepare and maintain laptops (Windows/macOS) for newcomers, handling global hardware shipments, setup, and collection
  • Address and resolve technical issues reported by employees, both remotely and on-site (software, hardware, connectivity, and access problems)
  • Manage and administer SaaS tools including Google Workspace, JumpCloud, Slack, Miro, CRM platforms, and VPN access (NordLayer)
  • Support system upgrades and improvements, ensuring tools are up-to-date and secure
  • Assist with access management for internal systems like CRM, NordPass, KnowBe4, and other platforms
  • Document processes and updates clearly to build a scalable, resilient IT infrastructure
  • Conduct regular system audits, maintain accurate asset inventories (hardware/software)
  • Work cross-functionally to deliver smooth onboarding, solve incidents, and enhance employee IT experiences
  • Support the functionality of office peripherals such as printers and meeting room technology including projectors and video conferencing systems
  • Manage the process of retiring and disposing of old IT equipment in a secure and compliant manner
  • Contribute to user training and guidance on basic IT tools and best practices as the role evolves
  • Manage and maintain office internet infrastructure, ensuring stable and secure connectivity at the office




Your Skills And Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in a similar IT support or system administration role
  • Hands-on experience in dynamic environments with Google Workspace, JumpCloud, Slack, Windows/macOS device management, and SaaS tools
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform Administration is a strong advantage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills for both hardware and software issues
  • Good understanding of IT security principles, access management, and endpoint protection basics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proactive mindset, attention to detail, strong organizational skills
  • Fluency in English (both verbal and written)
  • Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and growing into a senior IT role over time
  • Demonstrates a proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges, taking ownership to drive results independently
  • Hands-on experience with MikroTik network devices is a plus
  • Ability to manage and maintain office internet connectivity, including monitoring quality, troubleshooting user-level network issues, and escalating to ISPs or vendors when necessary to ensure stable and secure office operations




Benefits For You

  • 🚀 360 Growth: We provide limitless learning opportunities: access to platforms like Reforge and CoachHub, global conferences, physical and digital libraries, and feedback culture. Advance your career with internal mobility and grow with a team eager to share knowledge and support your success
  • 🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work on your terms: from a modern office in Yogyakarta or your home office. Enjoy flexibility in managing your schedule and bring your ideas to life in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • 💪 Wellness simplified: Your health comes first with insurance from Day 1, gym memberships,Headspacesubscriptions, recharge leave, and regular health checks. Join sports, arts, and hobby clubs or simply enjoy the balance of a lifestyle that prioritizes wellness
  • 🎉 Work hard - party hard: Recognize hard work with company events, Town Hall, Meet the Client initiatives, team-buildings, and workations. Celebrate life’s big moments with milestone gifts for weddings, new parenthood, and graduations

Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan

Kami sedang mencari Manajer R&D yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT NOSA JAYA KARYA', sebuah perusahaan otomotif terkemuka di Jakarta. Sebagai Manajer R&D, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam memimpin tim penelitian dan pengembangan, mengembangkan produk-produk inovatif yang memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan. Posisi ini memerlukan keahlian teknis yang kuat di bidang rekayasa otomotif serta kemampuan kepemimpinan untuk mengarahkan tim kreatif Anda.

Tugas dan Tanggung jawab

Riset Pasar dan Inovasi

Melakukan riset terhadap produk kompetitor, bahan baku, dan teknologi baru di industri otomotif.

Menganalisis tren pembelian konsumen di marketplace untuk menentukan arah pengembangan produk berikutnya.

Menemukan inovasi yang dapat meningkatkan daya saing produk di pasar.

Pengembangan Produk Baru

Mengidentifikasi tren pasar dan kebutuhan konsumen untuk menciptakan produk baru yang kompetitif.

Merancang dan mengembangkan produk aksesoris motor baru dari tahap konsep hingga siap produksi.

Melakukan uji coba produk (testing & quality control) sebelum diluncurkan ke pasar.

Bekerja sama dengan tim desain dan produksi untuk memastikan kualitas, fungsionalitas, dan estetika produk sesuai standar perusahaan.

Manajemen Proyek Pengembangan

Menyusun timeline dan anggaran pengembangan produk.

Mengawasi jalannya proyek R&D agar sesuai dengan target waktu dan biaya.

Mengkoordinasikan kerja sama antar divisi (produksi, desain, marketing, dan QC).

Evaluasi & Peningkatan Produk

Melakukan evaluasi berkala terhadap produk yang sudah ada, untuk meningkatkan kualitas dan efisiensi.

Mengidentifikasi masalah atau kekurangan produk berdasarkan feedback dari pasar dan pelanggan.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim produksi untuk melakukan improvement produk secara berkelanjutan.

Dokumentasi & Pelaporan

Membuat laporan riset, hasil uji coba, dan pengembangan produk.

Mendokumentasikan seluruh data spesifikasi produk, formulasi bahan, dan proses produksi.

Menyusun laporan perkembangan R&D untuk disampaikan kepada manajemen.

Kolaborasi Strategis

Berkoordinasi dengan vendor atau supplier untuk mencari bahan baku atau teknologi baru.

Mendukung tim marketing dengan informasi teknis dan keunggulan produk untuk kebutuhan promosi.

Menjadi penghubung antara tim kreatif, produksi, dan manajemen dalam pengembangan produk baru.

Tujuan Utama R&D Manager

Meningkatkan inovasi produk perusahaan.

Menjamin kualitas produk terbaik dengan biaya efisien.

Menjaga perusahaan agar selalu unggul di pasar kompetitif melalui produk yang unik dan relevan.

Kualifikasi Umum

Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Teknik Industri, Desain Produk, Teknik Mesin, Manufaktur, atau bidang terkait.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang pengembangan produk (R&D), diutamakan dari industri otomotif, aksesoris motor, atau manufaktur.

Memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang proses pengembangan produk — mulai dari riset pasar, desain, uji coba, hingga produksi massal.

Mampu melakukan analisis tren pasar dan kebutuhan konsumen untuk menciptakan inovasi produk yang relevan.

Mampu bekerja sama dengan tim lintas divisi (produksi, desain, marketing, dan QC).

Memiliki kemampuan manajemen proyek (project management) dan perencanaan produk yang baik.

Berorientasi pada hasil, kreatif, detail, dan memiliki kemampuan problem solving tinggi.

Mampu membuat laporan dan dokumentasi teknis dengan baik.

Menguasai penggunaan software pendukung desain atau analisis produk (seperti AutoCAD, SolidWorks, atau sejenisnya) menjadi nilai tambah.

Kualifikasi Tambahan (Nilai Plus)

Memiliki pengalaman dalam riset material atau proses produksi aksesoris kendaraan.

Memahami proses quality control dan standar produk otomotif.

Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik antar tim.

Mampu beradaptasi cepat terhadap tren dan teknologi baru di industri otomotif.

Mampu mengelola timeline dan anggaran proyek R&D secara efisien.

  • Develop forecasting models to predict daily/weekly/monthly sales across Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Tokopedia
  • Utilize historical data, market trends, seasonality (9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12), and brand activities to build accurate projections

Junior IT Project Manager

Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia

As a Project Manager you are expected to plan, execute, and close projects while ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet the desired quality standards. You need to ensuring that all project objectives are met and delivering successful project outcomes.

Job Description

  • Coordinate internal and third party/vendor resources for successful project implementation.
  • Ensure that all projects are implemented on time, within scope, and according to the established budget.
  • Help define the scope and objectives of the project, involve all relevant stakeholders and ensure the technical feasibility of a project.
  • Develop a more detailed project plan to monitor and measure the progress of a project.
  • Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule and project costs using appropriate verification techniques
  • Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques
  • Report and escalate to management as needed
  • Build and maintain relationships with customers and all stakeholders in the project including third parties/vendors
  • Carry out risk management to minimize project risks
  • Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
  • Delegate project tasks based on individual strengths, skills, and experience levels of project members.

Job Requirements

  • Maximum 28 years old
  • Minimum Bachelor degree in Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering
  • Minimum 1 years experience as Project Manager
  • Good at leadership, communication & negotiation
  • Highly motivated person, passionate, adaptive & honest
  • Able to work with targets & under-pressure, team player
  • Experience in infrastructure (virtualization, backup, server, storage) is preferred
  • Certified in Project Management (PMP, Prince, Scrum Master etc) will be an advantage

About Neon

Neon is a global payments and e-commerce platform designed to help game publishers earn more money and independence from app stores. We believe commerce should be open and transparent: clear decisions, actionable insights, and aligned incentives. Founded by payments, fintech and gaming veterans, Neon focuses on product and partnership excellence: we share the playbook, co-pilot decisions, and abstract away risk and complexity for our customers. We’re replacing old-school, black-box relics with clear, modern, and developer-centric infrastructure.

As an early team member, you’ll have the opportunity to shape and scale Neon’s product and culture, making a direct impact on our growth and success. You’ll join a collaborative, diverse team from world-class companies like Apple, Affirm, Unity, and Visa, backed by renowned VC's including Thrive, a16z, Griffin Gaming, Ribbit, and Renegade. If you want to build disruptive technology, challenge the status quo, and help game creators thrive on their own terms, read on.

The Role

The Payment Operations Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day execution of Neon Pay’s payments operations. You’ll manage dispute resolution, fraud investigation, and transaction performance tracking — providing the data and insights that fuel our payment optimization and risk strategies.

This is a hands-on operational role that sits within the Payments function, working closely with product managers and partners to ensure accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage dispute and chargeback processes from intake to resolution.
  • Conduct fraud investigations and escalate patterns to product and risk leads.
  • Track and analyze performance metrics such as authorization rates, decline reasons, and fraud losses.
  • Support reporting and KPI tracking for payment optimization and risk performance.
  • Document workflows, maintain compliance standards, and identify areas for process improvement.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and external partners to strengthen operations and data accuracy.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years’ experience in payments operations, fraud/risk operations, or financial services.
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data dashboards and performance reporting tools.
  • Detail-oriented, process-driven, and proactive in identifying inefficiencies.
  • Strong communicator, able to work effectively across product, operations, and external teams.

Compensation Range: $70K - $90K

Join the revolution in hospitality tech!

Liven is a leading global data, technology, and customer experience provider for the hospitality industry. From humble beginnings, we have grown to serve over 6,000 venues and millions of diners across Australia, the USA, and Southeast Asia, processing over 120 million transactions worth more than $3 billion (AUD) annually.

At Liven, our platform is built to help hospitality businesses save more and work smarter by seamlessly integrating every aspect of their operations — from ordering and payments to back-of-house management.

Driven by a deep passion for the hospitality industry, we continuously innovate to elevate the experience for both venues and their guests. Our solutions are powered by AI-enriched insights and automated workflows, enabling smarter decision-making and smoother operations at scale.

We’re proud to be an AI-first organisation. By automating repetitive tasks, we free up space for our teams — and our customers — to focus on what truly matters: solving complex problems, delighting guests, and driving meaningful growth.

Key Milestones

  • Expansion: Acquired OrderUp, Abacus, Zeemart, Copper and Nomnie forming Asia Pacific’s largest end-to-end group in hospitality technology.
  • Global Reach: From Melbourne to New York, Singapore to Jakarta, and all the way to Chennai, our presence spans major cities across the globe.

If you're someone who thrives on creativity, bold thinking, and using technology to make things better, faster, and smarter — you’ll feel right at home here.

Here’s a Quick Glimpse Of Liven

  • You can visit Career
  • You can visit LinkedIn
  • You can Visit Blog
  • Acquisition News

About The Role

At Liven, we’re transforming the way businesses in hospitality and beyond connect with their customers. As a Client Onboarding Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in helping new clients unlock value from our platform from day one. You’ll guide them through a smooth onboarding experience, ensure their account is configured correctly, and drive early activation of key features.

You will be the first trusted partner in their journey — supporting clients as they adopt the platform, resolving barriers early, and ensuring a confident, seamless transition into live usage. This role directly impacts client activation, product adoption, and long-term retention, making it essential to revenue protection and overall client satisfaction.

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage the end-to-end client activation and onboarding journey, ensuring a smooth progression toward successful go-live.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact during activation, building trust and strong client relationships.
  • Configure client accounts and set up platform workflows to support their operational needs.
  • Use CRM and onboarding tools to manage communication, track milestones, and maintain visibility across the activation pipeline.
  • Educate clients on Liven’s features and best practices to drive early adoption and engagement.
  • Identify risks, blockers, or technical issues early and resolve them proactively or escalate when necessary.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality activation experience.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in onboarding, client activation, client management, or other client-facing roles.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain concepts clearly and confidently.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with sharp attention to detail.
  • A client-focused mindset grounded in empathy, professionalism, and proactive support.
  • Comfortable using CRM systems, onboarding tools, and client support platforms.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Good to Have

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust quickly.
  • Confidence managing multiple activation or onboarding projects simultaneously.
  • Experience delivering training sessions, product walkthroughs, or client education.
  • A proactive approach to identifying risks or barriers and implementing timely solutions.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly.

descriptionHtml:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Conduct end-to-end design processes from understanding business and user needs, creating concepts, wireframes, prototypes, to final UI designs ready for implementation.
  • Coordinate with Product Managers to understand problems, feature requirements, user stories, and product priorities.
  • Collaborate with UX Researchers to leverage research insights and validate solutions through usability testing or other methods.
  • Develop and present design solutions to stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, and prototypes to visualize and validate ideas.
  • Develop high-fidelity UI designs that align with UX/UI best practices.
  • Support implementation with the Engineering Team by ensuring the final output matches the design through design handoff, design QA, and effective communication.
  • Manage, develop, and maintain the Design System, including:
    • Creating, updating, and documenting UI components.
    • Ensuring consistency across platforms and squads.
    • Collaborating with Interaction Designers/Design System Owners to refine components.
    • Identifying gaps in the design system and proposing improvements.
    • Advocating for and enforcing Design System usage across Design and Engineering teams to ensure consistent and scalable output.
  • Iterate on designs based on feedback, data, and usability testing results to improve user experience quality.
  • Keep up with design trends, technology, and best practices to continuously enhance product design quality.
  • Actively participate in brainstorming sessions, co-design workshops, or design critiques to generate creative and data-driven design solutions.
  • Document design processes, design decisions, and guidelines for internal knowledge sharing.
Persyaratan

  • Bachelor's degree graduate from preferably Computer Science, Informatics/Information Systems, or DKV major or related fields.
  • Minimum 2 years of work experience as a Product / UI Designer with experience in delivering end-to-end design for digital products.
  • Proficient in design tools: Figma (primary), Adobe Creative Suite, or other supporting tools.
  • Understands UX/UI principles, design thinking, and user-centered design.
  • Able to create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI.
  • Familiar with usability testing, heuristics, and interpreting research insights.
  • Understands design systems (creation & implementation).
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills (PM, Engineering, Research).
  • Nice to have: Experience creating or implementing a design system is a plus.

Other Requirements

  • Able to work independently or collaboratively within a squad.
  • Has a portfolio relevant to Product Design experience.
  • Data-driven and able to leverage user insights.
  • Strong at prioritization and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Possesses a growth mindset and strong attention to detail.

MAKE HISTORY WITH US!

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business, and building our future on smoke-free products with the power to improve the lives of a billion smokers worldwide.

With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

Role Overview

You are highly driven to constantly innovate and drive positive change, but more importantly, you consistently deliver great results. As a data engineer in PMI Business Solutions, you will have the opportunity to be a part of something different. This position offers exceptional opportunities for every candidate to grow their technical and non-technical skills. If you are selected, you have the opportunity to really make a difference to our business by inventing, enhancing and building new system, delivering results, working on exciting and challenging projects.

To find out more about eligibility to apply for internal jobs, please refer to the Open Sourcing Employee Guidebook on the Internal Careers Portal.

Your ‘day to day’

  • Creating, Testing and Deploying Pipelines: Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines for efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery.
  • Ensure Data Completeness and Quality: Implement mechanisms to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and consistency across all data sources and processes.
  • Optimizing and Maintaining Warehouse: Continuously improve the performance and scalability of the data warehouse, implementing optimization techniques and best practices.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization and automation, striving for continuous improvement in data management practices.
  • Data Analysis: Analyze and interpret data to provide actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, supporting data-driven decision-making processes.
  • Work with Vendors: Collaborate with external vendors to integrate new data sources into the data ecosystem, ensuring seamless data flow and integration.
  • Problem-Solving: Leveraging innovative approaches to optimize processes and enhance data quality.
  • Proactive Role: Actively anticipate and resolve potential data issues before they escalate, demonstrating a proactive approach to data.

Who we’re looking for

  • You have graduated in (Business) Informatics, IT, computer science or a related field.
  • 5 + years of experience working with SQL Server such as Snowflake, S3 buckets, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins or GIT.
  • Proficient in SQL and an additional programming language such as PowerShell or Python.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ideal candidates will have a deep understanding of technical and functional designs for Databases, Data Warehousing, ETL, Reporting, and Data Mining areas.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and techniques, including dimensional modeling and schema design, to ensure efficient data storage and retrieva

Preferred Qualification

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including agile methodologies, coding standards, code reviews, source management, build processes, testing, and operations.
  • Implement standardized, automated operational processes to deliver accurate and timely data for reporting to meet or exceed SLAs.
  • Understanding of development and management of data infrastructure and service.
  • Proven success in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior management to collect requirements, describe data modeling decisions and data engineering strategy.
  • Experience working directly with remote technical teams

Please note that only online applications will be taken into consideration. Only selected candidates will be contacted.

About SCG in Indonesia

Since 1992, SCG has contributed to Indonesia’s growth through cement, packaging, and building materials. Today, SCG is accelerating its digital transformation journey, embedding technology into operations, customer engagement, and supply chain management.


For digital professionals, this is an opportunity to lead change projects that integrate innovation, efficiency, and sustainability into SCG’s businesses in Indonesia.


About the Role

The Digital Transformation Officer drives projects that modernize processes, digitize workflows, and support SCG’s innovation initiatives in Indonesia.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify opportunities to improve operations through digital solutions.
  • Support ERP, automation, and data-driven initiatives.
  • Track digital project performance and adoption rates.
  • Research emerging technologies for relevance to SCG’s operations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver transformation projects.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or Engineering.
  • 0–3 years in digital projects; new graduates are welcome.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, process mapping, or digital tools.
  • Strong analytical and project coordination skills.


Career Development

Opportunities to grow into program management, digital strategy, or cross-border transformation roles across SCG’s network.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT Security team. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on-site in BSD and gain hands-on experience in maintaining the cyber security posture of our organization.

______________________________________________________________________________


Blue Team (L1 Shifting)

  • Act as Incident first responder for a 24/7 SOC Operations
  • Monitor security sensors and review logs to identify network anomalies or intrusions
  • Perform initial analysis of security alerts
  • Escalate security incidents using established policies and procedures in a timely manner


Blue Team (SOC Analyst - L2)

Detect, investigate & respond to cyber threats as part of the defensive (Blue) team. Own incident analysis, threat hunting, and remediation coordination.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze & triage high-fidelity alerts (SIEM/EDR/IDS)
  • Conduct deep-dive investigations using logs, network traffic, and endpoint data
  • Hunt for hidden threats using MITRE ATT&CK & threat intel
  • Contain incidents & coordinate remediation with IT/ops
  • Tune detection rules to reduce false positives
  • Document incidents & contribute to reports
  • Mentor L1 analysts; solve the complex cases


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Have 5+ years of working experience as SOC Analyst
  • Proficient in SIEM (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar), EDR (CrowdStrike, Defender)
  • Solid grasp of TCP/IP, Windows/Linux, attack tactics (MITRE ATT&CK)
  • Certs: CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or equivalent (preferred)
  • Scripting (Python/PowerShell) a plus


______________________________________________________________________________


Yellow Team [CLOSED]

  • As a Security Architect - Create and enhance security architecture
  • Assessing complex IT environments and mapping the data flow of the through systems/applications and organizational functions.
  • Architecting and designing cybersecurity solutions for multi-tenant managed security services environment
  • Designing shared services / cloud infrastructure environment
  • Acting as an expert in cyber defense activities, and building of substantial experience in design, implementation and validation phases for security monitoring projects (SIEM architecture design, IDSP deployment)
  • Facilitating architecture sessions to develop enterprise security architecture that fits within clients existing environment


Green Team (Security Compliance) [CLOSED]

  • Conduct Risk Assessments: Regularly evaluate network security measures and conduct vulnerability assessments to identify weaknesses
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain documentation of network security policies, procedures, and incidents, providing detailed reports to management
  • Conduct Security Awareness


Red Team [CLOSED]

  • Deliver Red Team Exercises
  • Conduct state-of-the-art penetration testing against web applications, network infrastructures, user workstations, network appliances and other devices and technologies.
  • Manual and automated security testing of Web applications, APIs, and Mobile Applications.
  • Do code review
  • Static and Dynamic testing (SAST & DAST) of thick applications
  • Develop Proof-of-Concept (PoC) for the identified vulnerabilities.
  • Provide remediation guidance to identified vulnerabilities.
  • Develop and execute security testing project plans


______________________________________________________________________________

General Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Strong interest in cybersecurity with a desire to learn and grow in the field.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and firewalls.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Familiar with code review and any programming languages e.g Go, Java (for Red Team)*
  • Available for shift work (for Blue Team L1)*
  • Willing to work onsite in OCBC Space (BSD City, Tangerang)


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, or CISSP.
  • Experience with incident response and security operations.
  • Understanding of industry compliance standards (e.g., PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR).
  • Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation.


______________________________________________________________________________


Join our dynamic team and take the first step towards a rewarding career in IT security. If you are ready to embrace new challenges and contribute to cyber-safeguarding our organization, apply now!


*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

descriptionHtml:
Make an impact with NTT DATA

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA

The Associate Software Development Engineer is an entry level subject matter expert, tasked with assisting with designing, developing, and testing software systems, modules, or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud-based or internet-related tools.

This role is accountable for assisting with for detailed design for certain modules/sub-systems, doing prototype for multi-vendor infrastructure, and showcasing it internally or externally to clients.

This role designs and develops functionality in a micro-services environment working with APIs, telemetry data, and running ML/AI algorithms on it, working with both structured and unstructured data.

Key responsibilities:

  • Receives detailed instructions to design and develop solutions and functionality that drives the growth of business.
  • Assists with writing and testing code.
  • Assists with the execution of automated testing.
  • Takes directions from various stakeholders to participate in software deployment.
  • Assists with delivering software components while working in collaboration with the product team.
  • Supports the integration and building of solutions through automation and coding, using 3rd party software.
  • Receives detailed instructions to craft, build, and debug large scale distributed systems.
  • Assists with writing, updating and maintaining the technical program, end-user documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Assists with refactoring code.
  • Assists with the reviewing of code written by other developers.
  • Performs any other related task as required.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

  • Developing in programming languages such as C/C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, libraries and frameworks.
  • Some expertise of data structures, algorithms, and software design with strong analytical and debugging skills.
  • Knowledge of micro services-based software architecture and experience with API product development.
  • Some expertise in SQL and no-SQL data stores including Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Cassandra.
  • Basic understanding of container run time (Kubernetes, Docker, LXC/LXD).
  • Some proficiency with agile, lean practices and believes in test-driven development.
  • Possess a can-do attitude and one that takes initiative.
  • Ability to work well in a diverse team with different backgrounds and experience levels.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Some proficiency with CI/CD concepts and tools.
  • Some proficiency with cloud-based infrastructure and deployments.
  • Excellent attention to detail.

Academic qualifications and certifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a relevant field.
  • Minimum 6 months hands-on programming experience
  • Experience in any tech stack (Java, .NET, Python, etc.)
  • Eagerness to learn and collaborate in a dynamic environment

Required experience:

  • Fresh Graduates are welcome to apply! A solid internship or personal project portfolio will be a significant advantage.
  • Entry level experience working with geo-distributed teams through innovation, bootstrapping, pilot, and production phases with multiple stakeholders to the highest levels of quality and performance
  • Experience in any tech stack (Java, .NET, Python, etc.)
  • Familiarity with working with large data sets and ability to apply proper ML/AI algorithms.
  • Entry level experience in software development.

Workplace type:

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Equal Opportunity Employer

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters—whether in writing or by phone—in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an @nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us.

Corporate Innovation Asia (CIAS) is a hands-on consultancy dedicated to enabling corporate talents to design, develop, and deploy innovation to drive business performance. CIAS specializes in providing tailored consulting services to enhance innovation capabilities within organizations. We are committed to helping companies navigate the complexities of today's business environment through creative and effective solutions.


Role Description

Mainly responsible for designing, developing, and delivering innovation-themed programs for client projects:

  • Develop customized innovation program proposals for prospects e.g. capability development workshops, project-based innovation/incubation programs, strategic meetings, innovation competitions, innovation consulting, s/webinars, etc.
  • Collaborate with Consultants/Trainers in modifying or creating learning modules, content (e.g. frameworks, cases), and tools (e.g. canvass) for program materials e.g. Design Thinking, Agile Development, Strategy, Lean Startup, Business Model, Innovation Pitching, Innovation Project Management, Leadership, Thinking Skills, etc.
  • Manage the design of new products and re-design of existing signature products.
  • Lead sales meetings as Consultant to advise on the best programs for prospects.
  • Advise and guide Project Team in program initiations and ensuring alignment.
  • As Product Team Lead, manage a team of Analyst(s).

This role is not to for digital products or the like, but rather to create products in the form of innovation consulting services.


Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of working experience in consulting company, preferably in innovation or people development consulting.
  • At least 1 year experience as team leader or supervisor.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a hybrid work environment
  • Experienced in developing content and proposal slide decks for consulting or learning programs.
  • Proficient in delivering product sales presentations to prospects/clients.
  • Skillful in doing research using various references (articles, books, journal, etc) for content development.
  • Strong in conceptual thinking, analytical skill, creativity and innovation.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Management, Psychology, or Education Technology.
  • Fluent in written English is necessary, fluent in conversational English is preferable.

George Gee Cadillac KIA is looking for experienced Used Car Technicians to join our reconditioning department! If you enjoy working on a variety of makes and models and are dedicated to quality workmanship, this could be the perfect role for you.

We’re proud to be ranked #2 among Extra-Large Best Places to Work in Washington, reflecting our strong commitment to a supportive and rewarding workplace culture.

Position Overview

As a Used Car Technician, you’ll be responsible for inspecting, diagnosing, and repairing pre-owned vehicles to ensure they meet our high standards. You’ll work with a wide range of vehicles, preparing them for sale and making them road-ready for our customers. The ideal candidate would have several years of diagnosing and repairing used vehicles at either new car dealerships or independent shops.

Used Car Technician Job Responsibilities

  • Conduct thorough inspections of pre-owned vehicles to identify any mechanical or cosmetic issues.
  • Perform necessary repairs, and maintenance to ensure each vehicle is in excellent condition.
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure efficient reconditioning processes and meet inventory goals.
  • Maintain accurate records of repairs and services performed.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards and company policies.

Used Car Technician Benefits And Compensation

Along with competitive pay we offer…

  • Competitive hourly pay with the potential for overtime pay.
  • Health Insurance starting at under $100 per month.
  • Dental, Vision, Pet and Company Paid Life Insurance.
  • Employee Assistance Plan.
  • 401k with Company Match.
  • Paid Time Off that accrues from Day 1.
  • An excellent menu of voluntary benefits.
  • Employee pricing for you and your family on vehicles, parts and service.

Used Car Technician Qualifications

  • Prior experience as an automotive technician, preferably with experience in reconditioning or used vehicles.
  • Strong knowledge of vehicle systems, diagnostics, and repair techniques.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

Corporate hiring requirements: 18 years or older with a clean driving record, valid driver's license, able to pass criminal background, and drug screen

If you’re ready to help us provide top-quality pre-owned vehicles to our customers, apply today to join George Gee Cadillac KIA’s dedicated reconditioning team!

The Role

About This Role

We’re seeking a Graphic and Presentation Designer to create compelling visual content that helps us fulfill our mission to be the most helpful creative platform in the world. This role focuses on designing engaging presentation decks and other creative assets while collaborating closely with clients and internal teams.

This is part of our active talent pool. We review applications continuously, and strong candidates are kept under consideration and may be fast-tracked once a matching opportunity becomes available.

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST/EST

Location: Remote, open to candidates in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, or India.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and design engaging and professional digital/print assets and slide decks that align with client brand guidelines and storytelling requirements using various design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Canva, PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Figma
  • Handle multiple design projects per day across various industries.
  • Engage regularly with Customers, Team/Production Coordinators, Art Directors, Quality Specialists, and other Creatives.
  • Engage with Design Pickle's customers, understanding their queue and overall process, and address graphic design-related concerns effectively.
  • Collaborate closely with the Team Coordinator, Quality Specialists, and other team members to ensure design quality adheres to brand guidelines.
  • Visual Content Creation and Graphic Editing: Craft visually engaging, high-quality designs for various platforms, including social media, websites, and digital channels, by transforming raw visual assets into polished, high-quality designs aligned with client brand guidelines and messaging.
  • Organize digital assets, including images, project files, and graphics, efficiently.
  • Stay updated with the latest design software and techniques to ensure the highest quality output.
  • Provide additional services and support as required by the client.

Ideal Profile

Who We Are Looking For

At Design Pickle, we are a global team of dedicated professionals who combine creativity, expertise, and collaboration to deliver exceptional results. We seek individuals who bring skill, passion, and a fresh perspective, those who embrace challenges and contribute to our shared vision. Your unique strengths will help shape our work and drive our collective success.

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, and Figma.
  • Proficiency in Presentation Design tools such as Google Slides, PowerPoint, Keynote, and Canva.
  • Experience in crafting visually appealing designs aligned with brand guidelines.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills for efficient project execution.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to ensure client satisfaction.
  • English level: B2 or higher (spoken and written).
  • A strong portfolio with examples such as:
  • Social media and digital ads
  • Presentations (PPT/Google Slides)
  • Print materials (flyers, brochures, labels)
  • Merchandise designs
  • Web layouts (design only)
  • Logos and branding
  • Simple GIFs and infographics

Bonus Feel free to browse our work samples on our website and review the comprehensive scope of work before applying for this position. Our vision, purpose, and values guide how we work, collaborate, and innovate every day. We look for people who will embody these principles and help move Design Pickle forward.

Important: Brine Program

Before fully joining, you’ll go through a 2-week evaluation period called Brine during PST business hours. You’ll complete real design tasks to show your skills and speed. This step is required to move forward.

What's on Offer?

  • Create from anywhere! We are 100% remote
  • Fixed Hours, Every Week
  • Steady Income, Always on Time
  • Full Access to Adobe Creative Cloud, On Us
  • 14 Countries, One Global Creative Team
  • Grow as a Creative Through Wide-Ranging Client Work
  • Amazing Culture Guided by our Core Values
  • Learn from the Best through our Creative Speaker Series

About Igloo

Igloo (formerly Axinan) is the first full-stack insurtech firm to emerge from Singapore. With offices across Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, China and India, Igloo is fueled by a mission of making insurance accessible and affordable for all. Igloo's innovation solutions empower companies to eliminate operational risk, drive new revenue streams and optimise and enhance their existing products and services. With a successful Pre-Series C fund round of US$36 million in Dec 2023, Igloo has now raised over US$100 million. The leading regional insurtech firm looks to expand regionally with strategic acquisitions and hiring great talent.

As a passionate team building meaningful solutions to make an impact, we are looking for like-minded individuals to join us at Igloo. At our core, we prioritise teamwork and foster a culture built on strong collaboration and we are looking for talented people like you.

Role Summary: The Technical Owner

The Regional Solutions Architect is the foundational technical resource responsible for the design, integrity, and successful deployment of Igloo Tech Solutions for our enterprise clients across the Asia Pacific region. This role acts as the technical bridge, translating complex client needs (especially from financial services and insurance giants) into deployable solutions using our modular, AI-powered platform.

You will play a direct role in commercial growth by winning the technical argument and ensuring a clean handoff to delivery, taking ownership of the solution from the first demo through to the initial project phase.

Key Responsibilities & Functions

A. Technical Sales & Solution Design 

  • Solution Blueprinting: Lead technical discovery sessions to deeply understand client pain points (e.g., related to legacy systems, operational inefficiency, or distribution gaps) and design the optimal technical solution blueprint leveraging Igloo's platform (Turbo, UIP, UCP, etc.)
  • High-Fidelity Demos: Conduct compelling, tailored product demonstrations and technical workshops for executive (CTO, Head of Digital) and technical audiences, focusing on architecture, integration, security, and scalability
  • RFP & Proposal Leadership: Strategically manage the technical component of all Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and commercial proposals, ensuring absolute accuracy and a clear technical rationale for the proposed solution
  • Technical Vetting: Serve as the technical point-of-contact, addressing all due diligence questions related to system integration, API architecture, data security (e.g., PII handling), and cloud deployment models
B. Project Execution & Delivery Support (Startup Ownership)

  • Project Scoping & Handoff: Own the transition from sales to implementation. Provide the Project Management team with detailed, signed-off technical specifications, effort estimates, and risk logs to ensure a smooth, low-friction technical kickoff
  • Project Support: In a startup capacity, provide necessary technical support during the early delivery phase, guiding the client and internal teams on architectural decisions, integration sequencing, and initial configuration
  • Mitigation & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify potential technical blockers or scope risks during the pre-sales process (e.g., as learned from projects like CIMB PH and AmMetLife MY) and work with technical teams to define mitigation strategies before they impact delivery timelines
C. Product Strategy & Market Intelligence

  • Requirements Loop: Systematically capture, structure, and prioritize client feedback and functional gaps identified during the GTM process
  • Roadmap Influence: Act as the voice of the APAC client and market, collaborating closely with Product Managers to translate commercial opportunities and competitor intelligence (GTM and product features) into actionable input for the core product roadmap, especially around AI and data capabilities (e.g., AI Claims assistance, AI Sales assistance)
  • Enablement: Develop and maintain technical collateral, including architecture diagrams, integration guides, and internal competitive battlecards to enable the wider Commercial team


Requirements

A. Experience

  • Minimum 5+ years in a client-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Technical Solutions Engineer, or Principal Consultant) within an Enterprise B2B SaaS company
  • Deep domain expertise working with Financial Services and Insurance carriers in the APAC region
  • Proven track record of success supporting a sales team to achieve targets in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
B. Technical & Architectural Skills

  • Strong conceptual understanding of modular SaaS platforms that are configurable (not custom-coded) and delivered via a robust API-first strategy
  • Proficient in discussing system integrations, data models, cloud environments, AI implementations, and enterprise security protocols
  • Familiarity with the insurance value chain (distribution, policy admin, claims) and how technology (like Igloo's Tech Solutions) can be implemented alongside or parallel to legacy core systems
C. The Startup Mindset (Critical for Success)

  • Owner-Operator: Demonstrated history of taking end-to-end ownership of technical solutions from initial concept to successful project handoff
  • Proactivity & Bias for Action: Must be a self-starter with the curiosity to constantly learn about new market trends (e.g., embedded insurance, digital banks) and emerging technology (AI/ML) to develop new solution ideas
  • Exceptional Communication: Highly articulate and able to bridge the communication gap between business (commercial team, client executives) and deep technical teams (engineers, security team)
  • Agile Acumen: Experience working within an agile or fast-paced delivery environment, understanding the balance between architectural perfection and speed-to-market

Design Associate, Cloudkitchens - Indonesia

Who We Are

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

What You’ll Do

  • Draw Testfit & Schematic Design.
  • Develop an Interior Design scheme.
  • Technical detail development (interior & exterior components).
  • Research local codes and standards and address compliance in early design phases.
  • Coordinate test fits and schematic plans with MEP/FP and Structural engineering strategies.
  • QA/QC of internal drawing packages.
  • Assist with consultant coordination process and review of milestone deliverables.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1-3 years relevant experience as a designer with a strong background in interiors/hospitality/F&B and/or renovation / adaptive reuse.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Architecture, Interior design, or related fields.
  • Experienced with all project phases.
  • Proficient in Revit, AutoCAD, Adobe Suites.
  • Strong space-planning ability.
  • Strong ability in architectural representation, drafting, and detail development.
  • Detail obsession, able to go deep on tasks as needed, execute & perform duties with accuracy, raise attention to potential issues & communicate relevant information to all parties.
  • Ability to multitask plan development for multiple projects with short timelines.
  • Ability to coordinate architectural and engineering systems cohesively.

Why join us

  • Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
  • Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
  • Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.

What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our Indonesia office location. We believe that people do their best work when they are together. As a company, we’re in the marketplace of ideas and innovation. When you’re constantly innovating, changing how an industry works, inventing new products and processes - and we are doing all these things - we believe we’re better as a team in-person. That’s why all of our teams (except for our field-based roles) are now working from one of our office locations 5 days a week. Looking forward to sharing more about a Career of Substance at CloudKitchens.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

Job Title: Data Scientist

Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company: Axross Pte Ltd

Type: Full-Time

About Us

At Axross, we’re building advanced HVAC AI solutions to optimise energy efficiency in industries like pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and precision manufacturing. Our systems help manufacturers better control the production environment while reducing energy consumption, contributing to cost reductions and environmental sustainability.

We are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about applying data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to real-world industrial challenges. Join us in pushing the boundaries of innovation by developing intelligent systems that can drive significant energy and operational efficiencies.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement advanced machine learning models (e.g., reinforcement learning, supervised learning) for real-time optimization of HVAC systems.
  • Work with dynamic simulation models to predict and optimise the performance of industrial systems.
  • Analyse large datasets, including plant and environmental data such as temperature, humidity, and energy consumption metrics.
  • Build and refine predictive models for energy demand forecasting and optimise control strategies across different industrial applications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI engineers, product managers) to deploy models in production environments.
  • Design and evaluate experiments to test and validate model performance, ensuring alignment with energy efficiency goals.
  • Continuously enhance models to improve prediction accuracy and system control.
  • Present findings, analysis, and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Have at least 2 years experience with ETL processes and model optimization techniques like feature selection, hyper-parameter tuning, and model validation.
  • Proficient in programming languages like Python, R, or Java, with a strong foundation in designing algorithms using various data structures.
  • Solid understanding of dynamic simulation models and / or digital twins for system optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS) for deploying AI models.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex data insights to a diverse audience.
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience with predictive modelling algorithms like logistic regression, neural networks, decision trees, and heuristic models.
  • Ability to work efficiently with different teams and independently learn new concepts or techniques.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in energy optimization, manufacturing, or industrial IoT projects is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning and control theory is highly desirable.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with real-world impact.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing industry focused on sustainability and innovation.

If you’re excited about using data science and AI to solve industrial challenges and drive sustainable solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

PIPECARE Group is currently looking for UT/UTCD Data Analyst [Level 3] to our office in Jakarta.

By providing technology and service focused solutions to the international arena of the oil and gas industry, the PIPECARE Group of companies has been helping our customers ensure the integrity of their pipeline and facility assets for over 20 years. Due to our global focus and international growth, Pipecare is seeking experienced UT/UTCD Data Analyst [Level 3] to support our continued growth.

Selected candidate will be working with our project execution teams to ensure the timely and accurate reporting of in-line inspection results, with focus on our custom-tailored reporting solutions to satisfy our customers’ needs. This includes the review of customer requirement specifications, processing of in-line inspection data, the analysis and identification of pipeline features and anomalies within processed data sets, application of industry accepted anomaly assessment criteria, ensuring the quality and accuracy of the final results, and compiling the results of our inspection activities in a concise, comprehensive custom tailored report for our customers.

Industry/sector: Oil & Gas / In Line Inspection services

Qualification: DA in UT/UTCD technology [Level 3]

Min years of experience: minimum last 15+ years working as UT/UTCD Data Analyst

Other requirements: solution – oriented attitude; hands on approach; disciplined; team player; self-motivated

Responsibilities include:

    • Checking and approving the tool performance during the PTT
    • Checking the data quality of ILI runs
    • UTWM Data Analysis
    • UTCD Data Analysis
    • EMAT Data Analysis
    • Checking and implementing dig verification task at sites and preparing relevant reports
    • Reviewing the software inter phase
    • Reviewing software user manuals
    • Preparing/Reviewing DAD quality documentation
    • To ensure accurate tool sensitivity values are provided to TM in Tool Checklist
    • To prepare a specific Run assessment report
    • To identify obstructions in the pipeline; to produce technically valid Preliminary / Final report (if applicable)
    • To produce technically valid Preliminary / Final report
    • To inform HO-DAD about the results and/or to implement the results into the reports
    • To ensure that the coordinates are synchronized with the data
    • To alert the R&D regarding the software problems
    • To update the documentation
    • To produce updated standard quality procedures
    • To alert the DA Team Leader / DA Manager regarding the software problems
    • Execute all other tasks as requested by DA Team Leader or DA Manager and/or Executive Team within the assigned job role
Qualified Candidates will possess:

  • Minimum 4-year technical or engineering degree from an accredited university (experience in the analysis of in-line inspection data may be considered in lieu of education on case by case basis)
  • Prior certification as ILI PQ LIII Data Analyst in one or more of the following in-line inspection technologies: UTWM, UTCD, EMAT; or the ability to become certified
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in the analysis of in-line inspection data
  • Ability to learn proprietary software platforms; proficiency in Microsoft based applications is a must
  • Proficiency in English, both verbal and written
  • A professional, detail-oriented focus and attention to detail and high quality
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all organizational levels, prepare and make presentations to management and customers on all levels

Job requirements:

  • Ability to work for extended periods of time in a stationary position at computers and workstations
  • Ability to pass vision acuity and color differentiation examinations
  • Business travel may be required for internal training, internal meetings, site visits, and customer meetings [international travel may be required]
  • Ability to work flexible hours based on business and project needs
  • Ability to work either independently or within a team to ensure project success

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds
  • Mobility: Must be able to walk and climb to perform duties, including maneuvering within a refinery or plant environment and accessing elevated platforms via ladders and stairwells
  • Communication: Sufficient clarity of speech and hearing, or other communication capabilities, to communicate effectively
  • Focus and Multitasking: Ability to maintain focus and multitask effectively
  • Safety Equipment: Must be able to wear safety equipment as required by the safety department for personal protection, if/where needed in manufacturing environments.
  • Personal Mobility and Reflexes: Sufficient personal mobility and physical reflexes, with or without reasonable accommodations, to perform office duties and travel to off-site locations when necessary

About PIPECARE Group:

PIPECARE Group offers comprehensive In-Line Inspection Services to identify and size pipeline threats, Utilizing advanced technologies such as Magnetic Flux Leakage, Transverse Field Inspection, Ultrasound, and specialized tools, PIPECARE ensures precise detection and assessment of various pipeline anomalies.

What we do:

In-Line Inspection Services

PIPECARE provides In-Line Inspection Services to locate, identify, and size threats, supporting integrity management requirements.

Check out our AI Technology and other cutting-edge technologies by clicking the following YouTube Links:

PIPECARE Group - YouTube

SMART AI CALIPER - Inspection Experience Like Never Before

Inspection Technologies

Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, especially circumferentially oriented.

Transverse Field Inspection (TFI): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, primarily axially oriented.

Ultrasound (UT): Detects and sizes general and other metal loss anomalies with high depth sizing accuracy.

Ultrasonic Crack Detection: Detects and sizes cracks and colonies of cracks.

Caliper (Geometry): Detects and sizes deviations in the ideal circular shape of a pipeline (dents, ovalities, wrinkles, etc.).

Specialized Tools and Technologies

Combo Tools: Use multiple measurement systems in various combinations.

Specialized Tubing Technologies: Designed for Furnace and Downhole Operations.

  • Mengelola dan memonitor perangkat IT Infrastructure (Router & Switch) dan IT Security (NGFW, VPN, WAF, CSPM, EDR, Email Protection, Threat Intelligence, dll) yang ada di on-prem dan di cloud.

G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.

The whole world trusts us when it comes to physical or digital currencies. We increase the security and efficiency of the cash cycle in collaboration with central banks and the entire currency industry. As the market leader in advanced currency management, would you like to join us in shaping the future of payments?

Responsibilities:

  • Be responsible for the summary report of inventory working capital, transportation costs, and customer order lead-time.
  • Monitor the quality, quantity, cost, and efficiency of the movement and storage of goods.
  • Coordinate and control the order cycle and associated information systems.
  • Manage the inspection, shipping, handling, and packaging of supplies and equipment.
  • Be responsible for inventory analysis.
  • Be responsible for the good receipt form documentation.
  • Prepare packing document for goods issue.
  • Review and verify import/export shipment documentation and ensure accuracy and completeness (invoice, packing list, BL/AWB, COO, etc.).
  • Ensure full compliance with all-in-all import/export regulations, customs procedures, including HS Code classification, shipment planning, and reporting.
  • Check price and roll cost with the supplier and the forwarder.
  • Deal with warehouse and transportation parties for shipment arrangement.
  • Be responsible for stock preparation & export shipment.
  • Update order status & maintain the order/invoice database.
  • Be the backup of the reception function when necessary.
  • Other ad hoc projects as assigned.


Job Requirements:

  • Diploma holder in Business Administration or related discipline.
  • At least 5 years’ experience in order processing functions. Strong logistics, end-to-end export-import process, incoterms, and inventory/warehouse management background with proven order track records.
  • Strong interpersonal & communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, well-organized, service-oriented, initiative, and independent.
  • Good analytical mind and business sense.

﻿﻿Company Overview

 About the job Project Manager

Meratus Group is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centres.

At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.

We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.

Position Overview

Meratus Group is seeking a strategic and operationally strong Project Manager to managing and overseeing the execution of property development projects from pre-construction preparation, basic infrastructure development, main construction, quality and compliance audits, through to final handover. The role ensures the project is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with design standards, regulatory requirements, and quality expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-construction preparation

  • Review design drawings, technical specifications, and development plans before construction begins.
  • Prepare construction strategy, schedules, and detailed work plans.
  • Oversee site preparation including land clearing, temporary facilities, and utilities setup.

Basic Infrastructure Development

  • Manage the development of essential infrastructure such as:
    • Roads and site access
    • Drainage systems
    • Utilities (water, power, sewage)
    • Earthworks, land leveling, and soil improvement
  • Coordinate civil works and ensure compliance with engineering and safety standards.
  • Monitor progress and ensure infrastructure works are delivered according to plan and specifications.
Construction Supervision and Execution Management

  • Lead and supervise daily construction activities across contractors and consultants.
  • Monitor site progress, manpower deployment, construction methods, and material usage.
  • Ensure all works comply with approved drawings, standards, and building codes.
  • Conduct regular site inspections and resolve technical issues promptly.
  • Implement project control tools to track timeline, cost, and performance indicators.
  • Ensure effective coordination with architects, engineers, QS, and project consultants.

Cost and Time Management

  • Monitor construction budget and track expenditures against forecasts.
  • Identify cost deviations early and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain the overall project schedule and ensure timely completion of each construction phase.
  • Review BOQs, progress claims, and cost impact of design changes.

Testing, Commissioning and Handover

  • Oversee testing and commissioning of mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), and structural systems.
  • Ensure final inspections and approvals by relevant authorities are completed.
  • Coordinate site clean-up, finishing work, and quality checks before handover.
  • Prepare handover packages including warranties, manuals, certifications, and as-built documents.
  • Ensure smooth handover to owners, operations team, or property management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in property development

Why Join Meratus?

At Meratus Group, youll play a pivotal role in shaping the physical backbone of one of Southeast Asias most dynamic maritime and logistics networks. If youre passionate about infrastructure, operational excellence, and building long-term value through strategic asset management, we invite you to apply.

Apply now and help us build the future of integrated logistics.

We’re looking for an Interior Designer (Retail) who can translate our brand identity into inspiring, functional store environments. You’ll collaborate with the Creative, Project, and Operations teams to design retail spaces that enhance the SATURDAYS experience, balancing aesthetics, practicality, and customer flow.
