Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled Senior MEP Engineer to manage and oversee the Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems at Japfa The Learning Center. Candidate will ensure the seamless operation, maintenance, and efficiency of HVAC, electrical, fire protection, and plumbing systems while complying with safety regulations and sustainability standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design, Installation & Maintenance:

  • Oversee the design, installation, and maintenance of HVAC, electrical, and plumbing systems in JTLC.
  • Ensure that all MEP systems operate efficiently to provide optimal guest comfort and minimize downtime.
  • Conduct regular inspections, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting to reduce operational disruptions.
  • Collaborate with contractors and vendors for the installation and upgrade of MEP equipment.

Energy Efficiency & Sustainability

  • Implement energy-saving initiatives to enhance JTLC sustainability and reduce utility costs.
  • Monitor and optimize HVAC and electrical systems for efficiency and performance.
  • Ensure compliance with LEED, ASHRAE, and other environmental regulations.

Project Management & Coordination

  • Work closely with architects, civil engineers, and interior designers on JTLC renovations and expansions.
  • Manage MEP-related budgets, procurement, and vendor negotiations.
  • Supervise on-site MEP work to ensure it meets quality, safety, and timeline requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all MEP systems comply with hotel safety regulations, fire codes, and industry standards.
  • Conduct risk assessments and implement emergency response measures for MEP-related issues.
  • Train hotel/resort staff on basic troubleshooting and emergency protocols for MEP systems.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related Engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in MEP engineering, preferably in hotels, resorts, or hospitality projects.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical systems, fire protection, plumbing, and automation controls.
  • Experience with BMS (Building Management Systems) and energy-efficient technologies.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and other MEP software.
  • Excellent problem-solving, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with local building codes, safety regulations, and hospitality industry standards.

About EY:

EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in Consulting and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.

We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we work towards our ambition to be the best employer.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

We look forward you to joining us in the EYDS AI and Data team:

Ideally, you must have:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or above in Information Systems, Computer Science, Informatics, Electronics and Communications, or related disciplines.
  • Minimum 1-2 years (for Associate level) and 3-5 years (for Senior level) in data engineering.

Job description:

  • Collect, process, and analyse large data sets to identify trends and patterns.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and provide actionable insights.
  • Conduct data quality assessments and ensure data integrity.
  • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Technical skill:

  • Machine learning model deployment
  • CI/CD for ML pipelines (Azure Machine Learning)
  • Model optimization
  • API development and implementation
  • SQL
  • BI reporting

Tools:

  • Python
  • Power BI
  • Azure Data Factory

The opportunity:

You will help our clients navigate the business and technology transformation vision. We’ll look to you to provide our clients with a unique business and technology perspective on how technology can transform and improve their entire organization – starting with key business issues they face. This is a high-growth, high-visibility area with plenty of opportunities to enhance your skill set and build your career. 

Your key responsibilities:  

You’ll spend most of your time working with a wide variety of clients and your colleagues to deliver the latest trends, practices, technologies, and architecture to design, build and maintain scalable and robust solutions that unify, enrich, collaborate and deliver value.    

Skills and attributes for success:

  • Outstanding team player
  • High level of motivation
  • Strong work ethic
  • Self-starting attitude
  • Independent and able to manage and prioritize workload
  • Ability to quickly and positively adapt to change
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, client service, and technical writing skills, coupled with excellent executive presence.
  • Significant experience in managing and delivering medium to large teams on complex programs and projects.
  • Assessing, designing, architecting, and developing solutions leveraging the latest technologies and trends to exceed the business requirements
  • Unifying, enriching, and delivering value to derive insights and opportunities
  • Leveraging in-house and partners - platforms and solutions as needed and recommending and building new platforms/solutions as required to exceed business requirements
  • Communicating findings, recommendations, and opportunities to improve platforms and solutions
  • Demonstrating a deep understanding of technology, concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches
  • Seeking out information to learn about emerging methodologies and technologies
  • Clarifying problems by driving to understand the true issue
  • Looking for opportunities for improving methods and outcomes
  • Collaborating, influencing, and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
  • Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making 
  • Proven track record of sales and delivery in a consulting context with established client relationships and experience

What we look for: 

We’re interested in passionate individuals with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends. If you have a genuine passion for helping businesses achieve their full potential, then these role(s) are for you. 

What we offer:

  • Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
  • Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, on your way
  • Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

descriptionHtml:
We at Indepay | Setara Networks are here to revolutionize the Indonesian payment ecosystem by introducing one click checkout services in order to make transactions zero-fee, instant, and rewarding for the consumer.

On one side we're working with financial institutes to enable real-time account to account transfers through our platform, and on the other-side we're giving consumers a reliable and secure payment experience which is better than anything else they've experienced in the Indonesian ecosystem.

🚀 Where We Are Now: Series A Startup with Boundless Opportunities! 🚀

🎯 Our Vision for Payment Transformation: We're on a mission to disrupt the traditional online payment landscape. By pioneering a faster, safer, and incredibly simple payment solution, we're challenging the status quo of virtual account payments and setting a new standard for seamless transactions, enabling payment in just 20 seconds powered by open banking regulatory framework.

📲 Strategic Partnership with Top Brands: As we build a new category in one-click fast payments, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry leaders, partnering with top-tier D2C brands ranging from telco providers, banks, FnB, and OTT to create a network that redefines the future of online payments.

🚀 Your Opportunity to Innovate: If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make a significant impact, this is your chance to be part of something truly transformative and create value.

As a System Security Administrator, you'll play a pivotal role in fortifying our digital infrastructure, proactively identifying vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance across our cloud and on-premise environments. Partner with engineering and DevOps teams to embed security into every layer of our architecture, driving a culture of resilience and proactive defense.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of hands-on experience in system security, with deep expertise in cloud platforms like AWS and GCP. Your knowledge of threat detection, risk management, and security protocols, combined with proficiency in tools like Kubernetes and Jenkins, will be essential in crafting and executing strategies that protect our critical assets and enhance system integrity.

Join a multicultural team at the epicenter of transforming Indonesia's future payment industry. Seize this rare opportunity to be a game changer in an environment that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Don't miss out on the chance to be part of a live, dynamic company ready to soar to new heights in the coming year.

Ready to simplify and revolutionize transactions? Apply now and let's embark on this exciting journey to reshape the world of payments together! 🚀💳#IndepaySetaraJourney #PaymentsInnovation

What your current role should be like?

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in system security, proactively identifying and mitigating potential vulnerabilities across cloud and on-premise environments
  • Collaborate closely with DevOps and engineering teams to implement secure architectures and automation processes, ensuring continuous security monitoring and system integrity
  • Drive comprehensive risk assessments, audits, and security checks, leveraging tools like Kubernetes, Puppet, and Jenkins to enhance security automation and resilience
  • Exhibit hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP, applying best practices to manage secure, cost-effective cloud deployments
  • Maintain a strategic focus on threat detection and response, utilizing monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack for real-time insights and automated responses
  • Possess strong documentation and communication skills, ensuring clear articulation of security protocols, policies, and best practices to cross-functional teams and stakeholders

What will you do?

  • Risk Management and Monitoring: Perform regular risk assessments, audits, and security checks. Continuously monitor network activity to detect and respond to threats in real-time.
  • Collaboration and Implementation: Work closely with development teams to implement and automate system security processes and optimize secure architectures
  • Security Automation and Configuration: Automate security protocols efforts across the organization utilizing containerized deployment on Kubernetes. Manage configuration tools like Puppet or Chef to maintain system consistency and security
  • Deploy and maintain stateful services on Kubernetes, including databases, Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Elasticsearch, etc. on non-prod environments in Kubernetes
  • Setup and maintain monitoring of systems via Prometheus and Grafana to be on top of all production systems, go one step further with automated healing
  • Perform configuration management through Puppet, Chef or similar tools
  • Security Tool Utilization: Utilize Continuous Integration (CI) / Continuous Delivery (CD) tools such as Jenkins/Google Cloud Build/Spinnaker, with a focus on secure deployment processes
  • Cloud Security Management: Develop and maintain secure, scalable cloud architecture solutions using platforms Cloud Providers such as GCP and AWS
  • Optimize GCP/AWS usage to get maximum cost benefit from the deployed resources
  • Collaborate with peers as a subject matter expert on cloud, containers, virtualization technologies, automation, and DevOps
  • Build engineering tools, system dashboards, and monitoring alerts (ELK, StackDriver, CloudWatch) to avoid false alarms without missing actual ones
  • Monitor dependencies, integrations (APIs), and have hands-on experience with cloud services like VPC, Compute, Database, Document Storage, Messaging queues, etc
  • Install, administer, and troubleshoot network security solutions
  • Update software with the latest security patches and ensure the proper defenses are present for each network resource
  • Perform vulnerability and penetration tests, identify and defend against threats, and develop disaster recovery plans
  • Configure security systems, analyze security requirements, and recommend improvements
  • Configure and support security tools, such as firewalls and anti-virus software
  • Configure and support the exchange server
  • Lead external audits

Requirements

What do you have?

  • B. Tech/ M. Tech/MCA with minimum 3 years of experience in DevOps
  • Professional level cloud certifications in GCP/AWS are desirable but not mandatory
  • Passionate about solving challenges, taking ownership, and learning fast
  • Must be comfortable working in an early stage to growth stage company and should be able to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
  • Have a proven track record of success in previous roles and have worked in a similar setting, such as a Pre series A-B company will be a plus
  • A leader who takes fun in taking risks and understands that taking calculated risks is necessary for growth. They should have the ability to balance risk-taking with sound decision-making to build something innovative and groundbreaking
  • Advanced training certifications may be advantageous
  • Strong understanding and knowledge of computer, network, and security systems
  • Fast learner and stay up to date on emerging technologies
  • Collaborate and work in a start-up environment and go the extra mile
  • Ability to develop clear and concise documentation
  • If you possess the above qualifications and want to join a dynamic team of professionals, please submit your application

How do you do it?

  • Analytical and data-driven approach in day-to-day work
  • Ability to work well under pressure and deliver on commitments
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, and can think outside the box to proactively provide the right solution
  • Good communication skills and the ability to impact and influence
  • Strategic thinker who understands business opportunities to create a competitive advantage
  • Keen eye for detail and ability to multi-task with excellent time management and prioritization skills
  • Positive attitude and determination to succeed against all odds
  • Hands-on, independent, self-motivated, and a fast learner
  • Patience and perseverance are key attributes

Benefits

What do we offer?

You will be working alongside other passionate and talented people in a beautiful, spacious and well lighted office with all the perks and flexibility of a coveted technology product company. Besides, you will have a sense of purpose and excitement as we offer:

  • An opportunity to make a positive impact on the world by providing basic financial services to unbanked and underbanked people worldwide
  • An opportunity to define and develop a product for the global market
  • An opportunity to be part of the core team who will build a global company and define its culture and processes
  • An opportunity to move horizontally or vertically across geographies through multiple career paths
  • An opportunity to work at the frontier of modern banking solutions technology

Of course, we do have competitive salaries, long term incentives and many other generous benefits. We promote entrepreneurship culture and look forward to a budding ground for future entrepreneurs.

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

  • Memantau sistem keamanan, jaringan, dan endpoint menggunakan alat SIEM seperti Wazuh, Splunk, QRadar, atau yang setara.
  • Mengidentifikasi dan menganalisis potensi ancaman atau anomali jaringan.
  • Melakukan triase dan respons awal terhadap insiden keamanan sesuai dengan SOP.
  • Menyiapkan laporan insiden harian dan mendokumentasikan aktivitas keamanan.
  • Melakukan eskalasi insiden ke Tier 2 atau tim terkait bila diperlukan.
  • Melakukan pemantauan berkala terhadap kerentanan jaringan dan memberikan rekomendasi mitigasi.
  • Mendukung analisis kerentanan aplikasi atau jaringan sederhana dalam koordinasi dengan tim Pentester.
  • Mengidentifikasi tren ancaman untuk meningkatkan postur keamanan perusahaan.

Requirements

  • Minimal D3/S1 di bidang IT, Keamanan Siber, Teknik Informatika, atau disiplin terkait. (Fresh grads atau mahasiswa semester akhir dipersilahkan untuk mendaftar)
  • Pengalaman atau pengetahuan dasar tentang platform SIEM, khususnya Wazuh, Splunk, atau QRadar.
  • Pemahaman dasar tentang protokol jaringan (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS) dan teknologi keamanan seperti IDS/IPS, firewall, atau endpoint protection.
  • Familiar dengan kerentanan umum dan eksploitasi (contoh: OWASP Top 10, CVE, atau CWE).
  • Keterampilan analitis untuk mendeteksi pola atau anomali dalam log keamanan.
  • Pengalaman dengan alat pengujian kerentanan sederhana (contoh: Nessus, OpenVAS, atau Metasploit) menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Sertifikasi seperti CompTIA Security+, CEH, Certified SOC Analyst, atau setara lebih diutamakan.
  • Bersedia bekerja dalam sistem shifting (6 hari kerja 2 hari libur. Dalam 1 hari dibagi menjadi 3 shift).
  • Bersedia untuk bekerja di Wisma 46, Kota BNI.

Dear Applicants,

Were looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Design Intern to join our team at Feazer. If you have a strong eye for design, are eager to learn, and stay up to date with the latest visual trends, wed love to meet you!

Youll support both internal and client projects, working alongside our creative team to produce visuals that resonate across digital platforms. This is a great opportunity to gain real-world experience in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.

Please note: This internship requires a 3-month minimum commitment.

What Youll Do:

  • Assist in creating visual assets for Feazers internal projects (e.g. social media, branding, campaigns, presentations).
  • Support designers with client-related tasks when needed.
  • Collaborate with team members to bring design briefs to life.
  • Participate in creative brainstorming sessions and contribute design ideas.
  • Follow brand guidelines to ensure visual consistency.
  • Manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


What Were Looking For:

  • Final-year student or fresh graduate in Visual Communication Design, Graphic Design, or related fields.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing skills in different design areas.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Knowledge of Figma is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and visual aesthetics.
  • Willingness to learn and openness to constructive feedback.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).


What Youll Gain:

  • Firsthand experience with agency-style design workflows.
  • Exposure to real client projects and internal branding initiatives.
  • A learning-focused environment with feedback and mentorship from Project Managers and experienced designers.
  • Opportunities to work across various design types: digital, print, branding, presentations, UI.
  • Improved soft skills including communication, teamwork, and client understanding.
  • A potential offer for full-time employment based on performance.


Additional Benefits:

  • 100% remote work.
  • Monthly stipend.
  • Reference letter upon successful completion.
  • A collaborative, supportive, and creative work environment.


To Apply

Please include a link to your portfolio in your CV.

Explore more about us at www.feazer.com were excited to see your creativity in action!

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly organized and strategic PMO Manager to oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of cross-functional projects within a fast-paced manufacturing and FMCG environment. This role will establish project management standards, provide governance, and ensure timely delivery of initiatives aligned with business goalsranging from product innovation, operational efficiency, digital transformation, to expansion projects.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Project Governance & Framework

  • Define and implement standardized project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, hybrid) across departments.
  • Establish and maintain project governance structures, reporting protocols, and risk management practices.
  • Ensure all projects comply with internal processes, budgets, and timelines.


2. Portfolio Management

  • Manage the companys overall project portfolio, prioritizing initiatives based on strategic value, resource availability, and risk.
  • Provide visibility to senior management on the status, impact, and performance of ongoing projects.


3. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a central liaison between departments (e.g., R&D, Operations, Marketing, Finance, IT, Supply Chain) to align on project objectives and execution plans.
  • Monitor interdependencies across projects and proactively resolve resource conflicts or bottlenecks.


4. Project Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track progress, milestones, deliverables, and KPIs of all active projects.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards for executives and stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate risks, delays, and deviations from scope or budget.


5. Resource & Capacity Planning

  • Assist department heads in estimating resource needs and allocating manpower effectively across initiatives.
  • Monitor team workloads and adjust project plans to optimize productivity.


6. Continuous Improvement

  • Identify gaps or inefficiencies in project execution and propose process enhancements.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning by documenting best practices, lessons learned, and key success factors.
  • Lead post-implementation reviews to evaluate project outcomes and ROI.


7. Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support change management strategies related to project rollouts, especially in operational or digital transformation.
  • Ensure stakeholder alignment through regular updates, feedback loops, and transparent communication.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Industrial Management, or related field. PMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification is a strong plus.
  • Experience: 6-8 years of experience in project or portfolio management, ideally within FMCG, food manufacturing, or related industries.
  • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Asana, Trello, Smartsheet, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, resource planning, and risk management
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and leadership abilities
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work across multiple levels of the organization
  • Detail-oriented with a strategic mindset

About The Job Data Analyst (Marine Engineering)

Meratus Group is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.

At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.

We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.

﻿Position Overview

﻿﻿This position is responsible for collecting, monitoring, analyzing, and recording all relevant data related to vessel usage from the Ship Management division.

﻿Responsibilities

  • Monitor, analyze, and record consumption reports for Main Engines, Auxiliary Engines, and other machinery across various platforms; assist management in decision-making based on summarized data.
  • Monitor, analyze, and record engine performance reports for each vessel; provide recommendations regarding data quality to ensure continuous performance improvement and compliance with company standards.
  • Collect and analyze monthly lube oil consumption reports for each vessel; support management in decision-making and contribute to initiatives aimed at improving lube oil consumption to meet company standards.
  • Record all off-hire incidents from each vessel and prepare summarized reports for management review.
  • Record all incidents of collision and grounding, and compile summarized reports for submission to management.
  • Record Fresh Water Generator production data and prepare summarized reports for management.
  • Provide support for improvement projects conducted by the Research & Training team.

Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in Marine Engineering or related Engineering major.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience as Data Analyst.
  • Possess solid experience and knowledge in the engineering matters.
  • Willing to carry out administrative tasks.
  • Proper analytical thinking and communication skill.
  • Proficient in English.
  • Willing to be placed at Head Office, Surabaya.

About The Role

We are SmartCyber, a member of Cybertrend, one of the leading data science consultants in Indonesia.

At CYBERTREND, we bridge the gap between education and industry. Our mission is to create an educational and training ecosystem that aligns with industry needs, producing top-tier talents ready to compete globally. As a Web Developer & Learning Management System (LMS), you will be part of the core team, contributing to building the institution towards success and accelerating your professional career through innovative web solutions and efficient learning management systems.

Your responsibilities will include developing, maintaining, and optimizing the company’s website and LMS, ensuring seamless integration with other platforms, collaborating to enhance the LMS user experience, resolving technical issues and staying updated with the latest trends and technologies.

We Are Looking Someone With

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a web developer and/or LMS manager.
  • Strong skills in web programming languages (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and related frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Content Management Systems (CMS) and LMS platforms (e.g., Moodle, Blackboard, Canvas).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities with various stakeholders.

The Work You’ll Do

  • Web Development:
    • Design, develop, and maintain the institution’s or company’s website.
    • Use programming languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and front-end and back-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Node.js, Django).
    • Optimize websites for performance, speed, and responsiveness across various devices.
    • Ensure website security against threats and privacy breaches.
  • LMS Management:
    • Manage and maintain the LMS platform, including installation, configuration, and system updates.
    • Create and deploy online courses, including content uploads, course module creation, and providing assessment tools (quizzes, exams, assignments).
    • Provide technical support to LMS users, including instructors and learners.
    • Track and report learner progress and performance through LMS reporting tools.
    • Manage user databases, including registration, roles, and permissions.
  • Collaboration and Support:
    • Collaborate with faculty and staff to understand learning needs and implement appropriate technical solutions.
    • Provide training and support to LMS users to ensure effective platform utilization.
    • Work with IT and development teams to troubleshoot technical issues and enhance the system.
  • Maintenance and Optimization:
    • Perform debugging and troubleshooting on websites and the LMS platform.
    • Monitor system performance and identify areas for improvement.
    • Stay updated with technological advancements and current
What Cybertrend Can Offer You

  • The unique opportunity to work within data science and artificial intelligence solution for various industries – real world data science, AI , Data Management and Governance experiences
  • Investment in your personal growth and skill development (clear career paths, mentorship and coaching, learning development, etc)
  • Attractive compensation and benefits packages
  • An open-minded culture with innovative, autonomous teams
  • A clear set of company core values that guide everything we do: GROWTH mindset, SOLUTION oriented, INNOVATIVE achiever, COMPASSIONATE, GOTONG ROYONG and Cool & FUN

PwC Indonesia is an inclusive and equal-opportunity employer that does not discriminate based on physical disabilities, gender, race, religion, or age. Your application will be treated fairly and assessed solely based on job requirements and competencies.

At PwC, our people in strategy consulting focus on providing strategic guidance and insights to organisations. They analyse market trends, assess business performance, and develop recommendations to help clients achieve their goals. These individuals work closely with clients to identify opportunities for growth, optimise operations, and enhance overall business performance.

As a corporate and business strategy consultant at PwC, you will analyse client needs, provide consulting services across different strategic areas, and offer guidance and support to help clients develop and implement effective strategies that align with their business objectives and drive growth.

The Strategy & Operations Internship at PwC offers undergraduate and graduate students the opportunity to work with industry-leading teams on strategic consulting engagements. Interns will gain firsthand experience and insights into the consulting profession, working closely with our professionals in developing innovative solutions to complex business challenges.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support engagement teams in conducting research, analyses, and problem-solving related to client needs and business strategies.
  • Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, and proposals for clients.
  • Participate in meetings and workshops with both internal teams and clients to discuss project progress and findings.
  • Collaborate with team members to design efficient business processes and develop actionable insights.
  • Facilitate the development of recommendations to drive client business performance and growth.
  • Help maintain project documentation and ensure effective communication across teams.

Benefits of the Internship:

  • Direct experience working within a global consulting framework.
  • Exposure to senior leaders and industry experts.
  • Development of skills and competencies relevant to consulting and advisory roles.
  • Networking opportunities with PwC professionals during firm-wide events.
  • Potential consideration for future full-time positions upon successful completion of the internship.

Requirements:

  • A final year students and/or fresh graduates from reputable universities, majoring in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Management, Engineering, Computer/Technology sciences.
  • A minimum GPA is 3.5 (out of 4.00) or equivalent
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to think strategically and solve complex problems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Knowledge of business process improvement methodologies is a plus.
  • Enthusiasm for learning and the ability to adapt quickly in a dynamic environment.
  • Added value if you have strong skills in data science, technology-related, other relevant certifications (i.e: CFA)
  • Able to join full time for a minimum period of 3 months

ONLY SHORTLISTED CANDIDATES WILL BE CONTACTED FOR FURTHER RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Join our Sulzer Turbo Services, Purwakarta team within Services Business Unit division as Project Management to help us take service operation to the next level.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

Responsibility to receive hand over Project from Sales/Tendering and manage it until delivery to customers and completion of warranty period.

Estimated Travel Time:

  • Provide Sales and Cash Colletion update to Top Management in regular basis.

  • Bridge communication with respective parties including Customer for any disputes and settle it.

  • Responsible for billing/invoicing, revenue, and cash collection, updated regularly, and took necessary action to meet the target.
  • Conduct people and performance review: people development, competency review, succession planning, cross-culture, code of conduct, and compliance.

What you bring to Sulzer:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or on related field
  • Min. 5 years work related experience mainly in the engineered-to-order and services.
  • Proficient MS Office, incl. Excel and PowerPoint
  • Excellent understanding of integrated ERP
  • Fluent English and local language
  • Team player
  • Well organized and structured
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Pro-active and self-motivated mindset
  • Sense of commercial (financial acumen)
  • Multi-tasking

If you’re qualified with proven expertise in developing professional strategies and driving continuous improvement in Project Management, take the next step and make the most of your expertise and skills

This role is available in Purwakarta, Indonesia.

International applicants are welcome to apply with valid visa and work permit.

Have a question about the role?

Reach out to mariana.mariana@sulzer.com

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter, and more sustainable.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2025 in Brazil, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, South Africa, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Come and join our story!

Godrej Consumer Product Limited (GCPL), an India-based company, acquired the PT Megasari Makmur group (now operating as PT Godrej Consumer Products Indonesia) engaged in home care in 2010. GCPI has now grown into a leading Home and Personal Care company in Indonesia, with factories located in Bogor and Bekasi.


GCPI's flagship brands includes HIT in the household insecticide category, Stella in the air freshener category, and Mitu in the baby care and baby wipes category which are all market leaders in their respective categories. Responsibilities

  • Melakukan instalasi, konfigurasi, patching, dan upgrade pada sistem Data Platform (Data Warehouse, Big Data, dan MDM).
  • Mengelola user, role, serta akses kontrol pada berbagai lingkungan data.
  • Menjamin ketersediaan, keamanan, kepatuhan, serta recovery sistem.
  • Monitoring performa sistem (aplikasi, database, query, dan infrastruktur) serta melakukan tuning.
  • Menangani backup, restore, dan prosedur disaster recovery.
  • Melakukan troubleshooting serta menyelesaikan insiden pada sistem Data Warehouse, Big Data, dan MDM.
  • Mengelola data model, metadata, dan reference data dalam platform MDM.
  • Mendukung tim Data Governance dalam memastikan kualitas data, data stewardship, lineage, dan kepatuhan.
  • Bekerja sama dengan tim DBA, Data Engineer, Application, serta stakeholder lintas fungsi.
  • Membuat dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis (konfigurasi, prosedur, penanganan insiden).
  • Melakukan capacity planning untuk kebutuhan compute, storage, dan network.
  • Mengembangkan infrastruktur Big Data dengan automation dan tools modern.
  • Mendukung integrasi antar sistem (ETL/ELT, REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka, MQ, dll).
  • Menyediakan laporan, dukungan audit, serta monitoring operasional.
  • Siap standby 24/7 bila diperlukan untuk mendukung operasional kritis.

Requirements

  • Minimal S1 di bidang Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait.
  • Memiliki pengalaman 3–5 tahun sebagai System Administrator / Application Administrator / Data Platform Administrator (Data Warehouse, Big Data, MDM).
  • Menguasai Linux/Windows Server administration dan shell scripting.
  • Penguasaan SQL serta pengalaman dengan database relasional (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  • Pengalaman langsung dengan:

Data Warehouse: Oracle, Teradata, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Informatica, Talend, SSIS, dbt.

Big Data: Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, HBase, Spark, YARN), Kafka, Cloudera, Kubernetes.

MDM: Informatica MDM, IBM InfoSphere MDM, SAP MDG, atau setara.

  • Familiar dengan cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) dan container environment.
  • Pengalaman menggunakan monitoring tools (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Pengetahuan konsep data governance, hierarchy management, dan golden record.
  • Familiar dengan sistem storage, IAM, VPN, firewall, dan konsep high availability.
  • Mampu menulis dan memahami script (Shell, Python, Java, Perl, Ruby).
  • Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, analitis, dan komunikasi yang baik.
  • Dapat bekerja kolaboratif dengan tim lintas fungsi (Data Governance, DBA, Application Support, Security).
  • Memiliki sertifikasi profesional (Informatica, Cloudera, AWS, GCP, Azure) menjadi nilai tambah.

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

About The Role

At Tentang Anak, we move super fast because we work for the needs of 80 million Indonesian children & families that can’t wait. We seek people who are hungry to solve the problem, accountable & bring speed in everything they do.

The Child Health Manager will be pivotal in positioning Tentang Anak as the leading expert-driven company championing interdisciplinary excellence. Serving as both manager and individual contributor, this role strengthens the organization’s impact through integrated, evidence-based research initiatives while ensuring accuracy, credibility, and societal relevance across all outputs. Acting as the evidence backbone, the Manager provides the research, data, and analysis that underpin strategic decisions and external positioning.

Scope Highlights

  • Research & Evidence Generation – Lead literature reviews, study design, data collection & analysis (quantitative, qualitative, epidemiological, or clinical), translation of findings into practical recommendations.
  • Scientific Rigor & Compliance – Ensure research outputs meet high standards of credibility, validity, and ethical compliance.
  • Innovation & Forward Thinking – Explore and evaluate new tools, digital health technologies, and methodologies to advance child health outcomes.
  • Knowledge Translation – Synthesize and translate research findings into actionable knowledge products (publications, briefs, reports, guidelines).
  • Integration & Dissemination – Embed research evidence into organizational strategies, products, and interventions; present findings at professional forums.
  • Innovation & Forward Thinking – Identify, test, and evaluate innovative tools, methodologies, or digital health solutions to improve child health outcomes.
  • Capacity Building – Mentor junior researchers to foster a culture of innovation and evidence-based practice.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Child Development, or related field (PhD preferred). A medical degree will be considered an advantage.
  • Experience: 4+ years of applied research in health, epidemiology, child development, or social sciences, including study design, data analysis, and publication. Proven ability to conduct systematic reviews or meta-analyses.
  • Research Rigor & Ethics: Demonstrated expertise in designing and managing research projects (quantitative, qualitative, epidemiological, or clinical studies) with methodological rigor and full ethical compliance.
  • Knowledge Translation & Impact: Strong skills in translating research into actionable knowledge products (briefs, reports, guidelines) and integrating evidence into programs, products, or interventions.
  • Collaboration & Interdisciplinary Work: Experience working across disciplines (healthcare, education, technology, policy) and managing multi-stakeholder collaborations. Excellent stakeholder engagement and partnership-building skills.
  • Innovation & Forward Thinking: Proven ability to identify, test, and scale innovative tools, methodologies, or technologies to improve child health outcomes.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Ability to mentor junior staff or interns, fostering a culture of evidence-based practice and proactive problem-solving.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex research clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

descriptionHtml:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Merancang, mengembangkan, dan memelihara layanan backend serta API yang tangguh menggunakan Java (Spring Boot) dalam arsitektur mikroservis.
  • Mengoptimalkan sistem untuk performa, skalabilitas, dan keandalan di lingkungan terdistribusi.
  • Bekerja sama secara erat dengan Product Manager, Engineer Frontend/Mobile, dan QA untuk menyelesaikan pengembangan fitur secara end-to-end.
  • Berpartisipasi dalam diskusi arsitektur sistem, melakukan code review, serta memberikan bimbingan teknis kepada engineer junior.
  • Berkontribusi terhadap keunggulan teknis melalui unit testing, dokumentasi, observabilitas, dan praktik terbaik CI/CD.
  • Mendorong perbaikan berkelanjutan melalui refaktorisasi proaktif dan pengurangan utang teknis.
  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim DevOps dan SRE untuk memastikan layanan telah dilengkapi dengan monitoring yang baik, mudah diobservasi, dan tangguh di lingkungan produksi.

Persyaratan

  • Memiliki lebih dari 3 tahun pengalaman dalam pengembangan backend menggunakan Java dan Spring Boot.
  • Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat tentang desain RESTful API, multithreading, dan pola arsitektur backend.
  • Mahir menggunakan SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) serta memiliki pengalaman dengan Redis atau penyimpanan data in-memory lainnya.
  • Berpengalaman dalam membangun dan memelihara mikroservis di lingkungan yang terkontainerisasi (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiar dengan pipeline CI/CD, version control (Git), dan alat seperti GitLab, Jenkins, atau SonarQube.
  • Memiliki kemampuan pemecahan masalah yang sangat baik serta fokus tinggi pada penulisan kode yang bersih dan mudah dipelihara.
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan mampu bekerja kolaboratif dalam tim lintas fungsi.
  • Berpengalaman dengan Elasticsearch, S3, atau message queue seperti Kafka, RabbitMQ, atau Pub/Sub.
  • Pengalaman dengan bahasa backend lain seperti Golang atau Node.js merupakan nilai tambah.
  • Memiliki latar belakang dalam platform otomotif, fintech/pembayaran, atau sistem dengan throughput tinggi.
  • Familiar dengan stack observabilitas seperti Grafana, Datadog, atau Prometheus.

Sea Labs is at the core of the Sea platforms development, supporting diverse business lines from e-commerce, supply chain, games, payment and finance, among many others. The strong growth and unique positioning of Sea's e-commerce business, Shopee, spurred the launch of Sea Labs Indonesia. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.

About The Team

The Payment team, best known for their flagship product: ShopeePay, aims to develop a mature, world-class payment platform connecting individuals and businesses within Shopee ecosystem. Beyond ShopeePay, the Team also connects with a large number of local financial institutions to serve billions of Shopee and Monee users across the different markets.

Together, we aim to reach the forefront of cashless payment technology by providing a more accessible, secure and reliable payment network that empowers individuals as well as micro, small and medium enterprises around the globe.

Your main responsibility includes (but not limited to):

  • Test case design and planning
  • Functional testing via grey-box and white-box methodologies
  • Perform API interface testing, and API automation testing
  • Performance, security, and integration testing for system, module, API, and other tools
  • Bug analysis and tracking
  • Setting up and maintenance of testing environment
  • Development and maintenance of testing tools, automation of testing tools and scripts
  • Continuous improvement and research of testing process, skills, techniques, quality, and efficiency


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or other related disciplines
  • More than 3 years of QA experience
  • Master at least one programming language, prefer golang and python
  • Master on popular test tools such as postman, applium, lucust,charles etc
  • Strong technical skills and the ability to drive and complete testing of complex systems independently
  • Excellent logical and analytical thinking abilities to solve various technical problems.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and teamwork. Proactively analyze problems and develop countermeasures to address issues faced.

Job Title

Manufacturing Engineer, Process, Chemical

Job Description

The Manufacturing Engineer role is responsible for leading chemical process development for new product introductions, driving improvement initiatives to optimize existing processes and production performance, managing project execution, and applying statistical methods to resolve process challenges.

Your Role

  • Lead and support chemical process development and industrialization activities for new product introductions (NPI) and new technology implementation, ensuring robust and scalable manufacturing processes.
  • Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies and statistical engineering tools to develop, validate, and optimize manufacturing processes, ensuring high process capability and product quality.
  • Troubleshoot project-related and production issues, perform root cause analysis, and lead problem-solving initiatives to ensure process stability and drive continuous improvement.
  • Manage project activities, including process validation and verification, equipment design reviews, capacity analysis, BOM quantity calculations, review of control plans, and defining quality standards.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, engineering, operations, and quality teams to ensure seamless integration of new processes and technologies.
  • Achieve key performance metrics such as cycle time, OEE, and yield, ensuring readiness for production scaling and operational handover.

You're The Right Fit If

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field
  • Preferably 2-5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, coating applications, production operations, or related sectors. Fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are welcome to apply
  • Strong knowledge of chemistry and chemical processes
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Agile and adaptable, with strong interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a team
  • Proficiency in statistical tools (e.g. Minitab), CAD software (e.g. SolidWorks), risk assessment tools (e.g. FMEA)
  • Experience in project development and execution, as well as process development and improvement

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.

Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is an onsite role.

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

  • Learn more about our business.
  • Discover our rich and exciting history.
  • Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

Description

The Print Services Operator is responsible for a wide range of prepress and print production duties in support of DFLOW’s delivery of Print Services. You will ensure all material produced meets specification and quality standard for the DFLOW Print Services customers.

Responsibilities

About the Role

We're looking for a skilled Graphic Artist to process and prepare artwork for high-quality print production. You'll work with detailed briefs, troubleshoot files, preflight artwork, and ensure every job is 100% print-ready and meets customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret customer briefs and assess artwork files for print readiness
  • Fix and correct artwork files to meet print specifications
  • Conduct thorough preflighting and quality checks
  • Generate print layouts and perform colour separations
  • Collaborate with experienced operators using cutting-edge tools and workflows
  • Report to the Print Services Lead & Manager

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years' experience in print production or graphic design
  • Expert knowledge of graphic prepress and commercial printing requirements
  • High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (especially Illustrator & Acrobat)
  • Experience with Enfocus Pitstop (highly desirable)
  • Sharp attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines across varied project scopes
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Strong interpersonal skills for liaising with customers and team members

About DFLOW

DFLOW is a technical agency serving the global printing industry. Our goal is simple: create business efficiency through technology and people. We challenge conventional workflows and deliver better outcomes.

Codekeeper is accepting applications for the next two months and will fill the position as soon as we've found the perfect match.

About The Role

As a designer, your primary focus will be transforming customer needs into user journeys and creating visually appealing and intuitive interfaces. Your design skills will play a vital role in turning ideas into tangible products that our development team will bring to life.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Translate customer needs into user journeys and design beautiful and intuitive interfaces

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

🌐 codekeeper.co

What You Can Expect

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues
  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth
  • Regular team activities and gatherings
  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period
  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback
  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference

  • Proficient copywriting skills in English
  • Strong understanding of color theory and typography
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Additional Requirements

Additional Info

Please send an application that speaks directly to how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Tanggung Jawab Utama

  • Merancang, mengkonfigurasi, dan mengimplementasikan infrastruktur jaringan (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN).
  • Memastikan ketersediaan, kecepatan, dan keamanan jaringan perusahaan.
  • Melakukan troubleshooting terhadap masalah jaringan (server, router, switch, firewall, dll). Memantau performa jaringan menggunakan tools monitoring (misalnya: Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds).
  • Mengelola keamanan jaringan (firewall, IDS/IPS, access control, enkripsi). Membuat dokumentasi teknis terkait topologi jaringan, konfigurasi, dan prosedur kerja.

  • Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika / Sistem Informasi / Ilmu Komputer (atau pengalaman relevan).
  • Menguasai dasar-dasar jaringan (TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP).
  • Berpengalaman dengan perangkat jaringan (Cisco, Mikrotik, Juniper, Fortinet, Aruba, dll).
  • Memahami konsep keamanan jaringan. Kemampuan analisis dan problem solving yang baik.
  • Sertifikasi seperti CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Mikrotik MTCNA, atau setara menjadi nilai tambah.

Company Description

  • Grand Seminyak Lifestyle Boutique Bali Resort is located in the heart of Bali's dynamic Seminyak, Grand Seminyak is your gateway to an extraordinary escape. Nestled in the desirable Seminyak area, the resort is just a

30-minute drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport.

Tucked away amidst verdant tropical gardens with expansive views of the Indian Ocean, Grand Seminyak embodies the essence of the boutique resort experience. Unwind in artfully crafted suites, indulge in contemporary dining experiences, rejuvenate by the shoreline infinity pool, and bask on your private balcony, capturing the mesmerizing horizon.

Dive deep into the vibrant tapestry of Bali. Engage with Seminyak’s eclectic boutique culture and pulsating nightlife, or journey inward to the island’s soulful core, dotted with quaint villages, cascading terraced rice fields, and a mosaic of art, dance, and age-old crafts. Find serenity along hidden coastal enclaves where the symphony of waves and nature’s allure promise a therapeutic retreat.

Job Description

Operation & Maintenance

  • Ensure all building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical, operate at optimal efficiency.
  • Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize equipment downtime and extend asset life.
  • Respond promptly to guest and operational maintenance requests while maintaining minimal disruption to services.
  • Oversee repairs, upgrades, and daily operational checks of hotel facilities.

Safety, Compliance & Sustainability

  • Maintain compliance with local building codes, fire safety regulations, and health & safety standards.
  • Conduct regular inspections and safety drills in coordination with relevant departments.
  • Drive the hotel’s sustainability initiatives, including energy and water conservation programs.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of compliance records, inspections, and certifications.

Budgeting & Cost Management

  • Prepare and manage the annual engineering budget, including capital expenditure planning.
  • Monitor energy consumption and implement cost-saving strategies without compromising service quality.
  • Source, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts for equipment and services

Project Management

  • Lead engineering projects, renovations, and refurbishments, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to plan and execute capital projects aligned with the hotel’s long-term strategy.
  • Ensure all work meets quality and safety standards.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a skilled engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning.
  • Set clear performance goals, conduct regular evaluations, and provide coaching to team members.
  • Ensure proper staffing and training to support operational needs.

Collaboration & Reporting

  • Work closely with other department heads to support operational needs and special projects.
  • Submit regular reports on maintenance activities, energy management, and project progress to the General Manager.
  • Participate in management meetings and contribute to the hotel’s strategic planning initiatives.

Qualifications

  • A minimum 3 years in the similar role, preferable in the a luxury 5* hotel/ resort.
  • Strong preventive maintenance plan, time management, problem solving skill and technologically savvy.
  • Have the experience in project or renovation management will be advantage.
  • Highly motivated, passionate, energetic with excellent interpersonal skill.
  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal, communication and computer literacy skills.
  • Position applicable for Indonesian nationality only and preferably Bali domicile.

Additional Information

Competencies

  • Creative & strategic thinker with a strong eye for detail.
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, capable of inspiring a team.
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented with a proactive approach.

Job Purpose

Our continuous growth creates a demand for heavy maintenance lines. We service the Dash 8 Q400, Dash 8 100/300 aircrafts. Along with the CRJ100/200/700/900 aircrafts.

We expect applicants to be ready to work in a fast-paced work environment. Our role requires individuals to have excellent communication skills with a team player attitude!

Position Summary

The Aircraft Painter, under the guidance of the Production Manager, will be responsible for preparing surfaces and painting aircraft, parts, and components. They must ensure that all work complies with aviation standards, company quality procedures, and safety regulations.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Prepare aircraft surfaces by cleaning, sanding, stripping, masking, and applying protective coatings as required.
  • Mix and apply primers, paints, and finishes in accordance with manufacturer specifications and company procedures.
  • Follow technical drawings, manuals, and job cards for proper painting instructions and requirements.
  • Inspect completed work to ensure the quality, thickness, and uniformity of paint applications.
  • Maintain accurate records of materials used, processes followed, and work completed.
  • Ensure compliance with environmental, safety, and hazardous materials handling procedures.
  • Perform touch-ups and rework as necessary based on inspections or client feedback.
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas, tools, and equipment.
  • Collaborate with other technicians, maintenance staff, and supervisors to ensure project timelines are met.

Core Competencies

  • Accountability
  • Critical Thinking
  • Teamwork & Interpersonal Skills
  • Time Management
  • Adaptability
  • Attention to Detail
  • Communication
  • Technical Proficiency

Preffered Skills, Qualifications And Education Requirements

Education and Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical training in painting or aviation maintenance is an asset.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in industrial or aircraft painting preferred.
  • Familiarity with aviation coatings, paints, and chemicals (e.g., polyurethane, epoxy).
  • Understanding of aircraft structures and surface preparation methods.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical manuals, and specifications.
  • Knowledge of safety standards, including WHMIS, MSDS, PPE, and confined space regulations.
  • Must be physically fit and able to work in confined spaces and at heights.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

Work Conditions

  • Work may involve standing for extended periods, bending, crouching, and lifting.
  • Exposure to paint fumes, chemicals, and noise—proper PPE is mandatory.
  • May involve shift work, weekend hours, or overtime depending on project deadlines.
  • Work is typically performed in hangars, paint booths, or outdoor environments.

Typical Benefits Include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Life Insurance
  • Extended Health & Dental Care & Vision Care
  • Health & Wellness Benefits
  • Paid vacation in accordance with federal government requirements

Working Hours

Working hours are mainly 7:00 am to 3:30 pm, Monday-Friday; extra hours may be required to complete project deadlines.

How To Apply

If you are interested in this job opportunity and possess the required qualifications, please visit our website at www.jdaeromaintenance.com .

We appreciate all interested applications; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please quote the job title you are applying for in the email subject line.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and integration.
  • Collaborate with business and analytics teams to define data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Build and optimize data models to support BI tools, dashboards, and advanced analytics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with data governance policies.
  • Automate data workflows and monitor pipeline performance for reliability and scalability.
  • Work closely with data architects and functional teams to improve overall data ecosystem efficiency.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.
  • Experience in data engineering, data transformation, or data integration roles is a plus. Fresh Grad is welcome.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data using tools such as dbt, Informatica, Talend, or Apache Airflow.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and practical experience with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Scala, or Java) for automation and data manipulation.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating and preparing data for Business Intelligence (BI) tools, such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Tableau, ensuring optimized data structures for visualization and analysis.
  • Experience collaborating closely with business analysts, functional teams, and data consumers to translate business requirements into technical data solutions.
  • Exposure to version control systems (Git) and CI/CD workflows, ideally within an Agile development environment.

Technical Skills

  • SQL, Python, or Scala.
  • TL/ELT tools (e.g., dbt, Informatica, Talend).
  • Cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift).
  • CI/CD and version control (e.g., Git, Jenkins)

Soft Skills

  • Analytical Thinking Ability to interpret complex data processes, identify root causes of issues, and propose practical solutions.
  • Business Acumen Understands business processes and can translate functional requirements into technical data solutions that add measurable value.
  • Communication Skills Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including data architects, analysts, and business users.
  • Collaboration & Teamwork Works effectively within cross-functional teams, fostering cooperation between IT, data, and business units.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset Approaches challenges systematically, balancing technical precision with business needs.
  • Attention to Detail Ensures data accuracy and consistency throughout transformation and integration processes.
  • Continuous Learning Stays updated with emerging data technologies, engineering frameworks, and best practices.

Responsibilities

  • Craft and refine user-facing microcopy such as buttons, menus, error messages, onboarding flows, tooltips, and in-app notifications that are clear, concise, and aligned with the product voice.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX Designers and Product Managers to understand user needs, feature requirements, and ensure seamless communication within product interfaces.

  • Support ongoing grooming and R&D discussions by transforming technical or research findings into user-friendly in-product messaging.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Journalism, English, or a related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in UX writing or a related role.
  • Strong writing and editing skills tailored for digital interfaces
  • Experience conducting or participating in user testing for copy validation.
  • Familiarity with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma).
  • Familiarity with UX design processes and user research.
  • Knowledge of localization, accessibility, and content scalability
  • Strong user empathy and ability to think from a user’s perspective.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • High attention to detail and consistency.
  • Proactive, inquisitive, and adaptable in an agile R&D setting.

Specifying the Future of Construction

Reporting to the Technical Engineering Manager, your new role as a Specification Engineer will involve creating opportunities through specifications and influencing key decision-makers to deliver products and services within the Hilti portfolio. This is a vital position that shapes the construction industry—from concept and design all the way through to installation and maintenance.

What You'll do

  • Offering technical support and expertise to clients, ensuring they understand and implement the best passive fire protection solutions.
  • Working closely with Architects to integrate Hilti’s products into their designs and projects.

We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

descriptionHtml:
About The Team

The Data Analyst in the Workforce Management (WFM) team plays a key role in turning operational data into actionable insights that improve workforce efficiency and service delivery. This role supports business functions such as Collections, KYC, and Customer Service, ensuring that data-driven decisions lead to better forecasting, resource planning, and overall performance. In addition to reporting and dashboarding, the analyst is expected to identify trends, propose operational improvements, and contribute to data projects that solve real-world business challenges. This position offers the opportunity to deepen analytical capabilities and gradually expand into Python and RStudio-based analysis.

Job Description

  • Analyze historical and live operational data to support workforce planning, staffing, and efficiency monitoring.
  • Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and reports that track KPIs for Collections, KYC, and CS operations.
  • Work closely with WFM and RTFM to support scheduling, forecast validation, and performance monitoring.
  • Perform deep-dive analyses to uncover root causes, surface insights, and recommend improvements to workforce or operational processes.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders in business teams to translate operational questions into structured data analysis.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects by turning data insights into proposals and pilots.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity in all reporting and analytics outputs.
  • Begin expanding analysis using Python and RStudio, supported by the WFM team’s upskilling roadmap.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related fields.
  • Proficient in SQL, with hands-on experience in Presto and/or Spark.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and visualize data clearly.
  • Familiarity with spreadsheet tools (Google Sheets, Excel) and at least one BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
  • Strong sense of curiosity, initiative, and willingness to explore improvement ideas using data.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and communicating findings with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Organized and detail-oriented, especially in managing datasets, logic documentation, and repeatable workflows
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient in database management tools (SFTP, HUDI, Spark, etc), Python, R Studio is a big plus

Skin Game adalah perusahaan kecantikan asal Indonesia yang berfokus pada pengembangan produk perawatan kulit dasar yang sederhana, efektif, dan berbasis sains. Sejak berdiri, Skin Game konsisten mengutamakan pertumbuhan yang stabil dan berkelanjutan, dengan mengedepankan kualitas produk serta kepuasan konsumen.

Sebagai perusahaan, kami membangun budaya kerja yang berintegritas, kolaboratif, dan berorientasi pada dampak. Tim Skin Game percaya bahwa inovasi di industri kecantikan tidak hanya soal menghadirkan produk, tetapi juga menciptakan ekosistem kerja yang sehat, mendukung perkembangan individu, serta memberi kontribusi positif bagi komunitas.

Bergabung dengan Skin Game berarti menjadi bagian dari brand lokal yang berkembang pesat, dengan kesempatan untuk belajar, berinovasi, dan ikut serta membentuk masa depan industri kecantikan di Indonesia.

🏠 Kerja Hybrid dengan jam kerja dari 09:00 - 16:00

💰 Benefit Produk Skin Game Gratis!

🤝 Budaya Kerja yang Mendukung dan Kolaboratif

Tanggung Jawab

  • Mengidentifikasi dan menjalin hubungan dengan Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), influencer, affiliator sesuai dengan brand dan tujuan perusahaan dengan fokus utama untuk meningkatkan revenue growth
  • Bekerjasama dengan para partner MCN ataupun RM dari Ecommerce
  • Mengaktifasi komunitas affiliator sebagai wadah mencari & bekerjasama dengan para KOL / Affiliator
  • Memantau dan menganalisis metrik kinerja campaign untuk mengoptimalkan strategi dan memaksimalkan ROI.
  • Tetap update dengan tren media sosial, marketing influencer, dan platform yang sedang berkembang untuk meningkatkan efektivitas campaign.
  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim branding & marketing untuk memastikan konsistensi dan keselarasan dengan strategi pemasaran secara keseluruhan.
  • Bekerja dengan tim internal untuk membuat proposal dan rencana campaign yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan.
  • Mengidentifikasi, merekrut, dan memelihara hubungan dengan pihak yang sesuai untuk kebutuhan campaign.
  • Memimpin negosiasi kontrak, membahas harga, dan mencari peluang untuk revenue growth.
  • Mengawasi kinerja campaign, menganalisis insight data, dan memberikan laporan rutin untuk mengoptimalkan strategi kedepannya.

Kualifikasi

  • Minimal 1-2 tahun pengalaman di bidang Affiliate Marketing, Manajemen KOL, atau bidang terkait., dengan pengalaman di beauty industry menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Memahami tren kecantikan, perilaku konsumen, serta produk seperti skincare, makeup, dan haircare untuk menyusun campaign yang relevan.
  • Memahami karakteristik berbagai platform (Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Shopee, dsb).
  • Kuat dalam storytelling dan branding, serta memiliki selera visual yang sesuai dengan brand.
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, delegasi tugas, dan manajemen proyek yang baik.
  • Mahir dalam menggunakan Excel/Sheets dan pandai menganalisa data.
  • Personal traits: growth mindset, cepat berdaptasi, memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik, memiliki interest dan passion yang tinggi terhadap beauty industry

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

  • Mengawasi seluruh kegiatan operasional dispatch, termasuk dispatch operation, dispatch analyst, serta tim hardware & network engineer untuk memastikan operasional dispatch berjalan lancar dan efisien.
  • Mengatur, mendukung, dan mengembangkan tim dispatch agar mampu mengelola main fleet (dump truck, excavator, shovel, dll.) dan support fleet (grader, dozer, water truck, dll.) secara efektif.
  • Membangun dan menjaga komunikasi yang aktif dan produktif antara tim dispatch dengan departemen terkait seperti produksi, maintenance, dan engineering.
  • Bertanggung jawab atas pelaksanaan dan keberhasilan implementasi sistem Fleet Management System (FMS) di site.
  • Memastikan semua perangkat FMS (hardware & software) berfungsi optimal, serta melakukan koordinasi dengan pihak vendor bila diperlukan.
  • Memantau performa alat berat secara real-time dan melakukan tindakan cepat untuk mengurangi idle time dan meningkatkan produktivitas.
  • Menyusun SOP, pelatihan, serta pengembangan skill bagi tim dispatch.
  • Menyediakan laporan performa harian, mingguan, dan bulanan terkait efektivitas dispatch dan utilisasi fleet.


Kualifikasi:

  • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Teknik Pertambangan, Teknik Industri, Sistem Informasi, atau setara.
  • Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang dispatcher, fleet management, atau sejenisnya di industri pertambangan.
  • Memiliki pengetahuan dan pengalaman dalam menggunakan FMS
  • Mampu menganalisis data operasional dan membuat laporan performa fleet.
  • Menguasai konsep cycle time, productivity, fleet allocation, dan pemahaman alat berat tambang.
  • Terbiasa bekerja dengan tim multi-disiplin dan mampu mengambil keputusan cepat di lapangan.
  • Mampu memimpin tim kecil dan melakukan coaching/pelatihan.
  • Komunikatif, tegas, dan memiliki integritas tinggi.
  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam implementasi awal sistem FMS akan menjadi nilai tambah
  • Menguasai tools analitik seperti Excel tingkat lanjut, Power BI, atau software reporting lainnya akan menjadi nilai tambah
  • Memiliki kemampuan dasar troubleshooting hardware/network FMS akan menjadi nilai tambah
  • Lokasi bekerja di Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah
