descriptionHtml:
Requirements

Qualifications and Skills

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise-level Windows Server environments and Active Directory.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Strong experience with Windows security hardening, patch management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation.
  • In-depth experience with virtualization technologies (Hyper-V or VMware).
  • Solid understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, VPN).
  • Experience with backup and disaster recovery methodologies and tools.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

Preferred (A Plus)

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-100/101), CompTIA Security+, CISSP).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services (Azure AD, Azure VM, Sentinel, Defender suite).
  • Experience with identity management and single sign-on (SSO) solutions (e.g., SAML, OAuth, Okta).
  • Knowledge of SIEM systems and security monitoring.
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001).

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Active Directory And Identity Management

  • Design, administer, and maintain a complex Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) environment, including domain controllers, forests, domains, and trusts.
  • Manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) for security hardening, software deployment, and user configuration across the enterprise.
  • Administer Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) and hybrid identity solutions (Azure AD Connect).
  • Implement and manage identity and access management (IAM) solutions, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role-based access control (RBAC).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex AD replication, authentication, and DNS issues.

Windows Server Management

  • Install, configure, patch, and maintain Windows Server operating systems (2016, 2019, 2022).
  • Manage core infrastructure services including DNS, DHCP, DFS, and File/Print services.
  • Implement and manage Hyper-V or VMware virtualization platforms.
  • Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, and capacity planning.

Security And Compliance

  • Harden Windows servers and Active Directory according to industry benchmarks (e.g., CIS Benchmarks, NIST guidelines).
  • Develop and execute a rigorous patch management strategy for all Windows systems.
  • Implement and manage endpoint security solutions (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, etc.).
  • Configure and manage security tools such as Microsoft Defender for Identity, and Azure Sentinel for threat detection and response.
  • Conduct regular security audits, access reviews, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Respond to security incidents, participate in investigations, and implement remediation plans.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and relevant regulations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).

Automation And Scripting

  • Automate repetitive administrative tasks using PowerShell scripting.
  • Utilize DevOps principles and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools like Ansible, Terraform, or DSC for configuration management.

Backup, Disaster Recovery, And High Availability

  • Design, test, and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery solutions for critical infrastructure.
  • Implement high-availability configurations like Failover Clustering.

Collaboration And Support

  • Serve as an escalation point for help desk and other IT teams for complex issues.
  • Create and maintain detailed system documentation, network diagrams, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with network, security, and application teams on projects and initiatives.

About Sea Labs Indonesia

Sea Labs is at the core of the Sea platforms development, supporting diverse business lines from e-commerce, supply chain, games, payment and finance, among many others. The strong growth and unique positioning of Sea's e-commerce business, Shopee, spurred the launch of Sea Labs Indonesia. Since its inception, the group of passionate engineers have charted the course to drive the best experience for our users in Indonesia, many of which solutions are even adapted to other markets in the region.

Sea's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience world-class projects first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do. Together with our passionate and driven teams, you'll get to develop your skills, build on industry knowledge and collaborate with global teams in a dynamic space. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.

About The Team

Marketplace User Web Frontend team is responsible for the frontend development for Shopee’s ecommerce web platforms. We mainly focus on user-related features for both customers and internal operators. We design stable and scalable architecture to support Shopee’s fast business growth. Shopee serves millions of users, and we seek to push the limit of web technologies. We continuously innovate to build internal state-of-the-art engineering solutions.

  • Take ownership of various business features at Shopee
  • Give constructive feedback on product requirements, deliver tasks on time, provide positive user experiences
  • Contribute to the technical excellence of the team
  • Write clean and maintainable code, conduct thorough and candid code reviews
  • Participate in various internal technical projects and give technical sharing sessions
  • Make development plans, coordinate across different projects and tasks
  • Optimize development workflow, improve development efficiency and quality


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in computer science or related fields
  • Have around 1–2 years of experience in frontend web development, but not limited to this field
  • Good understanding of computer science fundamentals, including but not limited to algorithm, data structure, network.
  • Good understanding of web frontend fundamentals, including but not limited to JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Browsers
  • Good understanding of user experience


Good to have

  • Experience in React
  • Experience in TypeScript
  • Prior experience in a complex engineering project

descriptionHtml:
What is Build the Future?

Build the Future is one of the Prysmian Graduate Programs, now in its 15th edition!

We aim to hire talents globally with diverse background and experiences who are eager to make our world a more sustainable place and ready to embrace new challenges.

Are you willing to proactively take part to the Energy transition and Digitalization of our communities?

Be part of this important change and help us build a better future for all of us. Join us!

Program Overview

Our Graduate Program provides an immersive experience in our company from day 1.

The program starts with a one-week Global Induction in Milan with trainings and activities led by the Prysmian Academy in collaboration with a Top-Ranking Business School.

Following your induction, you will be part of a one-year job rotation in 2 different departments: Research & Development and Operations in one of our production sites.

After the first year of rotation, you will take a role in the Country you have been hired in for 12 months aligned to business needs and your interests. The position will be technical, mainly based in one of our production sites, strongly linked to the core of our business.

Then, after completing your second year, you will start your international assignment for a duration of 3 years in one of our 50+ countries.

You will learn new ways of working, acquire technical knowledge, meet colleagues all over the world in a multi-cultural environment!

At the end of your assignment abroad, returning to the country you have been hired in, you will be ready to take on a new responsibility in the technical area continuing your career in Prysmian.

What else is in for you?

  • A competitive reward package, including a bonus opportunity.
  • A training plan tailored for you in partnership with a Top-Ranking Business School.
  • Opportunity to continuously develop your knowledge through the Prysmian local schools.
  • A buddy who will help you to settle in quickly during the first year of your journey and a mentor who will provide guidance, support and knowledge to help you grow and develop as professional.
  • A wide range of training and career development opportunities based on performance.
  • Benefits when moving abroad for your international experience.
  • A global network of 300+ other colleagues who have already joined our graduate program.

Who are you?

  • You are keen on joining a career in our manufacturing industry and you are ready to embrace a new challenge.
  • You are eager to be trained on a technical role.
  • You have graduated in the last 24 months, or you are completing a degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) fields.
  • You speak English fluently.
  • You have worked or studied abroad and/or you are willing to join an international experience with Prysmian.
  • You have excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • You enjoy learning and working with other colleagues.
  • You are available to start by March 2026.
  • You are passionate about diversity and inclusion and keen on joining a multicultural environment.

Prysmian empowers every person to make a significant impact, uniting diverse roles and locations in a shared mission for a greener future, driven by energy, passion, and innovation. The company culture celebrates the synergy between people and the planet, fostering authenticity, empathy, and a sense of community that translates into tangible benefits for society and the environment. Ready to embark on a new journey?

Apply now and discover more on Graduate Program Build the Future | Prysmian

Prysmian , as an Equal Opportunity Employer, aims to attract and recruit individuals with diverse backgrounds, skills, and abilities. We strongly believe that diversity brings significant value at all levels of the organization, increasing the possibility of capturing market opportunities and maximizing value for our customers and stakeholders. With Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) as part of our Social Ambition 2030 and a strategic pillar of our Company culture, Prysmian is committed to the development of an organization that prioritizes talent, where people feel respected, included, and free to fully express their potential just as they are.

All Managers and HRs in Prysmian are responsible for ensuring DE&I policies are respected during the recruiting process, as well as recognizing and mitigating unconscious biases that must not influence our selection processes. All persons will be considered for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, nationality, origin, citizenship status, socio-economic status, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, parental leave, medical conditions, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Prysmian will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation for any disclosed physical or neurological condition or disability of a qualified applicant unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

Visit our DE&I Page to learn more about Prysmian's commitments.

Your application data will be treated according to our Data Protection Policy. If you believe you require assistance to complete this form or to participate in an interview, please let us know.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Head of Engineering to lead the development and operations of our logistics technology platforms that power both customer-facing experiences and mission-critical back-office systems. This role will oversee engineering for our funnel products (mobile/web applications that drive customer acquisition, revenue conversion, and order management) as well as our productivity operational systems (HR, Finance, Legal, ERP).

The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with a proven record of delivering large-scale, high-availability systems, managing sizable engineering teams, and driving innovation through modern software practices and AI adoption.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing engineering team (40+ engineers across mobile, backend, DevOps, and enterprise systems).
  • Partner with C-level leadership (Product, Operations, Finance, Commercial) to align technology execution with nationwide logistics and growth strategies.
  • Drive engineering culture focused on speed, reliability, scalability, and security.
  • Ensure technology decisions support operational efficiency in high-volume logistics environments.

Technology Ownership

  • Oversee development of customer-facing applications (iOS, Android, React Native, Node.js, Golang, Java) to drive funnel conversion, order tracking, payments, and client engagement.
  • Own and scale operational and back-office platforms (Odoo, HR, Finance/Accounting, Legal) with deep integration into logistics operations and nationwide delivery workflows.
  • Ensure applications stability that are streamlined with high TPS backends to perform seamlessly at scale.
  • Guarantee 99.99% uptime across mission-critical systems powering revenue generating activities.

Engineering Excellence

  • Champion CI/CD pipelines, trunk-based development, GitFlow, and test automation to support rapid, reliable deployments.
  • Drive adoption of AI/ML tools to accelerate development, improve forecasting, routing optimization, fraud detection, and anomaly monitoring.
  • Implement best-in-class security practices, ensuring compliance with data protection standards, logistics industry regulations, and financial integrity.
  • Lead system observability and incident response frameworks to minimize downtime and operational disruptions.

Operational Impact

  • Collaborate closely with operations teams to translate logistics workflows into scalable digital systems.
  • Build resilient platforms capable of handling nationwide network complexity, high concurrency, and peak demand during seasonal spikes.
  • Optimize infrastructure cost vs. performance for cloud-native environments (GCP/AWS).
  • Enhance back-office automation and reporting systems to streamline HR, finance, and compliance functions.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years in software engineering with at least 8 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
  • Proven success leading large engineering teams (40+ engineers) in operationally heavy, mission-critical environments.
  • Hands-on experience with scalable, high-throughput systems requiring 99.99% uptime.
  • Strong technical background in mobile/web platforms, microservices, real-time logistics/transaction systems.
  • Expertise in current stack: Swift, Kotlin, Golang, Java, Node.js, React Native, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kubernetes.
  • Deep knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, trunk-based development, and DevOps best practices.
  • Strong foundation in software security, secure architecture, and compliance frameworks.

Preferred / Good-to-Have

  • Experience in logistics, e-commerce, or fintech platforms with high operational complexity.
  • Familiarity with routing optimization, fleet management, supply chain integrations, or real-time delivery tracking systems.
  • Success in scaling platforms across a nationwide user and operations base.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML in logistics optimization (e.g., demand forecasting, route planning, predictive maintenance).
  • Experience with AI/ML for software delivery acceleration, personalization, or operational automation.
  • Prior success in balancing funnel (revenue-critical) systems and internal back-office platforms.
  • Exposure to enterprise-grade ERP systems integration and customization.
  • Strong financial literacy and experience collaborating with CFO/COO on cost optimization and system investments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership.

Key Soft Skills

  • Strategic mindset with ability to balance growth, operational resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Strong decision-making under pressure, especially in time-sensitive logistics environments.
  • Excellent communication skills to bridge technology, operations, and business stakeholders.
  • Passion for leading tech innovation in logistics and delivering measurable impact on nationwide operations.

Responsibilities

Research Analyst and Fund Management

At Principal, we invest in what matters. And building dedicated teams is where it all begins. We’re drawn to people who bring outstanding perspectives, passion, and expertise to help us advance the financial security and well-being of our customers. We also aim to transform our growing business and drive positive change in the communities where we live and work.

When we invest in you, and you invest in us, great things happen.

We are looking for an Research Analyst and Fund Management in Indonesia who responsible conducting research and analysis and providing recommendations on companies and preparing analysts and providing recommendations to investment managers with reference to the laws and regulations applicable in the Indonesian capital market.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct qualitative research, networking, and third-party checks.
  • Conducting detailed credit evaluations/reviews and producing credit papers for new credits and/or current holdings as investment recommendations to fund managers.
  • Conduct Bank Analysis (CAMEL) and prepare memos for approval by the Investment Committee regarding adding banks to the investable universe.
  • Ensure close monitoring of the bond universe, rating updates, brief reviews and formal annual credit reviews.
  • Conduct primary or secondary stock research for analyst stock scope or investment meetings based on internal processes and procedures.
  • Conduct writing related to ad-hoc activities such as meetings with government, industry experts, and other sources.
  • Maintain relationships with companies or publishers for stock coverage.
  • Monitor stock databases based on internal procedures.
  • Conduct investment processes and report production.
  • Provide investment managers with stock projections and ideas.
  • Participate and contribute to the updating of monthly Fixed Income discussion materials with Regional CIOs.
  • Regional: Fulfill work related to regional activities such as weekly investment meetings, bi-weekly investment meetings, monthly investment meetings, and quarterly investment committee meetings.
  • Local: Fulfill work related to local activities such as investment team meetings - marketing, and ad-hoc meetings with other divisions.
  • Contribute to internal teams across departments.
  • Provide data analysis for existing and new product development from an investment perspective.
  • Marketing:
  • Conducting stock market projection presentations for sales agents, marketing staff, and investors.
  • Executing marketing materials in accordance with the investment team's perspective.
  • Monitoring or analysing all equity portfolios in accordance with internal and external regulations, client-specific objectives, and existing restrictions if needed.
  • Trading:
  • Analysing data on all stock trading transactions in accordance with portfolio objectives, regulations, and internal procedures if needed.
  • Conducting stockbroker evaluation reports.
  • Analysing data related to stock portfolio transactions.


Qualifications

 Who You Are

  • Minimum bachelor’s degree majoring in Economics / Accounting
  • Mandatory holding WMI (Wakil Manager Investasi) Certification that has been approved by SK (Decree) from OJK.
  • Optional holding CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) certificatio
  • Minimum 3 years of experience working in the financial industry such as capital markets, insurance or banking, especially in the investment area.
  • Deep understanding of capital markets, including but not limited to the spectrum of equity management, bond and fixed income management, portfolio management, macroeconomics, qualitative analysis and valuation.
  • Have up-to-date knowledge of applicable regulations, especially in the capital market industry and not limited to POJK, SEOJK and other capital market regulations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex risk concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Able to communicate well in English (oral and written).


Additional Information

 Who We Are

Principal Financial Group is a Fortune 500 global leader in financial services specializing in insurance, retirement, and asset management. We have 18,000 employees and 51 million customers around the world with over $714B in assets under management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure Planning & Maintenance

  • Memastikan ketersediaan, keamanan, dan keandalan infrastruktur TI (server, jaringan, firewall, storage, dll).
  • Melakukan perencanaan, pengembangan, serta peningkatan infrastruktur sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan.
  • Melakukan pemantauan performa dan troubleshooting untuk mencegah downtime.

2. Network & Security Management

  • Mengelola konfigurasi jaringan LAN/WAN, VLAN, routing, switching, VPN, dan firewall.
  • Memastikan keamanan sistem jaringan dan menerapkan kontrol sesuai standar keamanan.

3. Server & Virtualization Management

  • Mengelola server berbasis Windows dan Linux.
  • Menangani platform virtualisasi (VMWare/Nutanix/Hyper-V), termasuk deployment, migration, backup, dan monitoring.

4. Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Menjalankan dan memelihara sistem backup rutin.
  • Memastikan kesiapan dan kelengkapan dokumen DRP.

5. Vendor & Asset Management

  • Berkoordinasi dengan vendor terkait layanan infrastruktur.
  • Mengelola aset infrastruktur TI, dokumentasi topologi jaringan, dan SOP operasional.

6. Audit & Compliance

  • Mendukung kebutuhan audit internal/eksternal.
  • Memastikan infrastruktur sesuai standar keamanan TI (ISO 27001).


Requirements

  • Pendidikan minimal S1 Informatika / Sistem Informasi / Teknik Komputer.
  • Pengalaman minimal 3-5 tahun dalam IT Infrastructure, dengan min. 1 tahun sebagai Supervisor.
  • Menguasai:
  • Windows Server & Linux
  • LAN/WAN, firewall, VLAN, VPN, routing & switching
  • Firewall (Fortigate/Palo Alto, dll.)
  • Platform virtualisasi (VMWare/Nutanix/Hyper-V)
  • Active Directory (DNS, DHCP, GPO)
  • Monitoring tools (PRTG, OPMANAGER)
  • Memahami standar keamanan TI (ISO 27001).
  • Sertifikasi pendukung lebih disukai (CCNA, MCSA).

About the Role

This role is about enabling the Development Teams towards an environment where continuous improvement is the norm and where everyone's common goal is having fun delivering high quality valuable working software continuously.

You will work with 1-3 cross-functional agile product development teams. You are a champion of Scrum and lean principles and always strive to see big picture.

You will work closely with Engineers, product, design, people team and other stakeholders across levels, including top management, collaboratively ensuring quality gets built into the product.

What you will do

With the team:

  • Coaching the team members in self-management and cross-functionality.
  • Helping cross-functional Team focus on creating valuable incremental outcome for the business that meet the Definition of Done.
  • Work on increasing transparency around work and collaboration to help team identify and remove impediments by themselves.
  • Help the team be better at development practices to ease change.
  • Ensuring that all Scrum events take place, are productive and team can learn from it.

With the product & stakeholders:

  • Helping find techniques for effective Product Goal definition and Product Backlog management.
  • Establish and improve towards empirical product planning for a complex environment; and,
  • Facilitating stakeholder collaboration as requested or needed.

With the people team and larger organization:

  • Work to build bridges between stakeholders and Scrum Teams.
  • Work on removing or reducing impediments that prevent Scrum Teams from working well.
  • Leading, training, and coaching the organization in its Scrum adoption.
  • Planning and advising Scrum implementations within the organization.
  • Helping employees and stakeholders understand and enact an empirical approach for complex work.

What you need to have

  • Enjoy reading books.
  • Beginner's mindset: Highly curious in learning new things and applying it in practice.
  • People First mindset: Care for people and highly curious about people development, group dynamics, and coaching.
  • Hands-on experience working with multicultural team in a product development organisation 5-7 years, from either 1 of these 3 backgrounds.
  • Product development.
  • Engineering.
  • Organisation and teams transformation / Scrum Master.

Good to Have:

  • Have a solid understanding of agile principles, values, and hands-on experience implementing agile in a multi team environment preferred.
  • Banking / Fintech domain experience is preferred.
  • Software engineering / Digital Product background is preferred.
  • Exposure to Lean/XP practices (TDD, Pair Programming, Continuous Integration/Delivery for Mobile) is Preferred. At least understand the principles behind it.
  • Exposure to Lean concept and systems thinking is preferred.
  • Immediate joiners Preferred.

Who you'll work with

Multicultural teams across our Tech Hubs (Jakarta, Pune, Singapore, and more hubs to come), building Jago Digital Life Finance Solutions, integrated with one of the largest ride-hailing ecosystem in SEA (South East Asia), and many others to come.

­Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, and Amsterdam, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

Job Title: Data Center Engineering Project Manager

The Data Center Engineering Project Manager will oversee the end-to-end delivery of data center projects, including design review, construction, commissioning, and operational handover. This role ensures that all engineering, construction, and operational requirements are met on time, within budget, and according to quality and compliance standards.

The position involves close coordination with multi-disciplinary teams — MEP, civil, electrical, IT infrastructure, and operations — to deliver hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centers.

This role is ideal for candidates with strong mechanical and electrical expertise, hands-on experience in hyperscale and Tier III+ data centers, and proven project management leadership.

While the position is based in our Cikarang data center campus, there is travel required across Indonesia and potentially other countries within Southeast Asia.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Project Management & Execution
  • Lead full project lifecycle: planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  • Develop, monitor, and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
  • Identify project risks, implement mitigation strategies, and escalate critical issues.
  • Prepare and present progress reports, technical documentation, KPIs, and milestone updates to management and stakeholders.
  • Oversee RFI/RFP processes, technical proposals, and feasibility studies (if applicable).
  • Engineering & Technical Oversight
  • Review, approve, and coordinate technical designs: electrical, mechanical, HVAC, fire protection, IT infrastructure.
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, Indonesian codes, and international data center standards (Uptime Tier III/IV, NFPA, IEC, TIA).
  • Supervise Testing & Commissioning (T&C) including Integrated System Testing (IST).
  • Validate redundancy, N+1/N+2/2N, etc. configurations, and operational reliability.
  • Oversee vendor, contractor, and consultant performance to meet technical specifications.
  • Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • Lead multi-disciplinary project teams, contractors, consultants, and internal engineers.
  • Act as primary interface between clients, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Mentor junior Facility Engineers and project staff, fostering knowledge transfer and operational excellence.
  • Ensure seamless communication and coordination across all stakeholders.
  • Compliance, Quality & Safety
  • Enforce adherence to engineering standards, corporate policies, and safety regulations.
  • Conduct QA/QC inspections to validate system installation and workmanship.
  • Support environmental, health, and safety (EHS) initiatives.
  • Operations Handover
  • Facilitate smooth transition to operations, including documentation for preventive/corrective maintenance.
  • Ensure operational readiness and uptime SLA compliance.

Key Requirements

Education & Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or Building Services Engineering.
  • Preferred: CDCP, PMP, ATD (Accredited Tier Designer), IPM (Insinyur Professional Madya).

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years in mission critical facility construction and commissioning, with the last 4-5 years leading the design of hyperscale data center infrastructure projects.
  • Proven track record in delivery of large-scale Tier III+ or hyperscale DCs (50 MW+), ideally in Indonesia / Southeast Asia, including commissioning phase supporting processes (FAT, SAT, IST, MOP/SOP)
  • Hands-on experience with critical systems: chillers, CRAH/CRAC, UPS, generators, LV/MV electrical distribution, BMS/SCADA, fire protection systems.
  • Direct experience working in a live project environment (construction, commissioning, power upgrades, equipment cutover)

Technical Skills

  • Strong technical competency in electrical, mechanical, fire protection, and HVAC systems.
  • Ability to review, interpret, and challenge engineering drawings and designs for data center projects
  • Strong familiarity with Uptime, ANSI/TIA, NFPA, IEC, ISO standards.
  • Demonstrated Ability to manage engineering deliverables across consultants and outside contractors.
  • Experienced in using and leveraging project management tools to provide visibility, reporting, and insights to projects: Primavera P6, MS Project, Procore, or equivalent.
  • Any candidate possessing experience with CxAlloy or BIM360 are highly encouraged to apply
  • Any candidate with experience in power utility permitting or substation interface are also highly encouraged to apply

Soft Skills & Leadership

  • Excellent leadership, team coordination, and stakeholder management.
  • Effective communication, negotiation, and problem-solving under tight deadlines.
  • Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.

At this time, we are only considered candidates local to Indonesia that have a valid work permit. No sponsorship is necessary at this time.

EdgeConneX believes inclusion – of thought, backgrounds and experiences – affects all that we do, from our employees to the solutions we deliver. Our goal is to create an environment where embracing differences helps deepen the lives and work experience of our employees, enhances our innovation and creativity, and enriches our involvement in our communities. EdgeConneX is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, as well as any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

EdgeConneX offers a competitive benefits package.

Hyundai Motor Asia Pacific – Regional Office (HMAP HQ) operates as the regional arm of Hyundai Motor Company, committed to advancing the future of mobility and fostering an EV ecosystem across the region.

Extending across Southeast Asia and the Pacific, HMAP HQ actively supports and collaborates with its subsidiaries in promoting and selling a diverse range of vehicles.

Our regional network includes sales subsidiaries, manufacturing plants, and distributor partners.


About Role


The role is responsible for establishing and executing comprehensive project plans, including the management of progress, schedules, costs, quality, and risks, while ensuring successful delivery and full accountability for project outcomes. The role involves coordinating data integration and analysis across internal systems, leading and implementing data-related projects, and identifying inefficiencies to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

  • Support global data integration and alignment across regional teams

  • Integrated an analytical thinking ability (problem recognition/analysis/solution)

  • Expertise in project management methodologies, product lifecycle management, and IT system implementations
  • Strong ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into actionable IT solutions
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Actively contribute to system evaluation, testing, bug tracking, and improvements to enhance product performance and end-user satisfaction
  • Excellent written and verbal communications in English
  • Domain knowledge in Sales, Customer, Product, Manufacturing, Service, and Quality data
  • Comprehensive understanding of IT systems and data architecture, including development frameworks, processes, system and data structures
  • Have experience and knowledge about data platforms or data analytics tools (e.g. PowerBI)

We are seeking a talented Python Developer to join our team and help build cutting-edge AI-based solutions, including intelligent chatbots and conversational AI systems. You'll work on developing innovative applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern AI technologies to solve real-world problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop AI-powered chatbots and conversational interfaces
  • Integrate Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, etc.) into production applications
  • Build and maintain REST APIs for AI services
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and vector databases
  • Design scalable and maintainable backend architectures
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Optimize AI applications for performance, cost, and user experience
  • Ensure security best practices in all implementations

Mandatory Requirements

Core Programming Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python 3.x with deep understanding of best practices
  • Solid grasp of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns
  • Understanding of asynchronous programming concepts and when to apply them
  • Experience with code organization, modularity, and writing maintainable code

AI & LLM Expertise

  • Understanding of how Large Language Models work (tokens, context windows, limitations)
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering principles and techniques
  • Understanding of when to use RAG vs fine-tuning vs prompt engineering
  • Awareness of AI limitations, hallucinations, and mitigation strategies

Backend Development

  • Experience building REST APIs with Python frameworks
  • Strong understanding of API design principles
  • Knowledge of database design fundamentals (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms

System Design

  • Ability to design scalable and maintainable system architectures
  • Understanding of performance considerations and optimization strategies
  • Knowledge of security best practices and data protection

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to break down complex problems systematically
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently

Preferred Qualifications (Advantages)

  • Experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack)
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS)
  • Experience with NLP libraries (spaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face Transformers)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure)
  • Experience with Docker and containerization
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Previous chatbot development experience (Rasa, Botpress, or similar)
  • Experience with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Portfolio of AI/chatbot projects

MonetizeMore builds industry-leading ad technology that is seen by more than 300M+ people per month. The company has been running for 15 years achieving consistent double-digit growth each year with a team of 100+ team members spread across the globe.

We are a culture-centric organization where 👥 Integrity, 🤝 Collaboration, 🚀 Enterprising, and 🔄 Kaizen unite for excellence. We meticulously cultivate these pillars at the heart of everything we do, and our 100% remote setup allows us to work anywhere while upholding these values.

Role Summary

We’re looking for a versatile Social Media & Creative Growth Specialist to own and execute the content, design, and growth strategy across social platforms — including YouTube — to elevate MonetizeMore’s brand, engage publishers, and drive inbound lead generation. This role blends creative design, storytelling, and growth strategy to make complex ad-tech topics accessible, build trust, and generate qualified publisher interest.

The ideal candidate will be a cross-functional producer: part designer, part content strategist, part growth marketer — comfortable with graphic design, video creation, and social strategy, and passionate about turning ad-tech know-how into compelling content with real business impact.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Content & Video Strategy (YouTube + Social):
    • Plan, produce, and publish high-quality videos, tutorials, explainers, and thought leadership content that address publisher pain points (e.g. policy compliance, invalid-traffic prevention, monetization best practices)
    • Develop and manage a content calendar for YouTube and social media channels aligned with company goals, ad-tech news, and publisher needs
    • Optimize video metadata, thumbnails, and descriptions to maximize discoverability, SEO, and engagement.
  • Graphic & Visual Design:
    • Create visually compelling graphics, diagrams, infographics, and motion-graphics that simplify and clarify complex ad-tech concepts
    • Design assets for marketing, sales enablement, social posts, blog posts, product announcements, and educational content.
  • Social Media Management & Community Engagement:
    • Manage and grow MonetizeMore’s presence across relevant social platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, etc.)
    • Engage with publisher and industry audiences, respond to comments/questions, and foster community trust and thought leadership
    • Repurpose content across formats (short-form, long-form, image, video) to maximize reach and engagement.
  • Lead Generation & Brand Awareness:
    • Use content and social strategy to attract high-intent publisher leads searching for ad-tech solutions or publisher support
    • Collaborate with sales and marketing to align content with lead-gen goals and track performance metrics (views, engagement, leads, conversions).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work closely with product, sales, ad operations, and client success teams to understand product features, publisher pain points, and trends — then translate into content
    • Support sales enablement with video and visual collateral (case studies, product explainers, onboarding content, policy update guides).
  • Continuous Improvement & Analytics:
    • Track performance of content (video views, watch time, engagement, conversion to leads)
    • Analyze what works, iterate on content strategy, and continuously optimize for growth, reach, and revenue impact
Qualifications & Skills

Required:

  • 3- 5 related years of experience.
  • Demonstrable experience in graphic design and video content creation (e.g. editing, motion graphics, thumbnails, design software)
  • Strong familiarity with YouTube (or other video platforms) — content production, optimization, SEO best practices, and audience growth
  • Experience managing social media channels for a brand or B2B company
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical/ad-tech topics into clear, audience-friendly content
  • Creative mindset with a strategic growth orientation — comfortable thinking about content as a lead-gen and branding asset, not just marketing fluff
  • Ability to work in a fully remote, cross-functional environment, collaborating with teams across time zones.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have:

  • Background or familiarity with ad-tech, digital publishing, programmatic advertising, or related industry
  • Experience producing explainer videos, motion graphics, educational content, or tutorials
  • Understanding of SEO, video SEO, and content performance analytics
  • Experience supporting sales or business development teams through creative/sales-enablement collateral

descriptionHtml:
Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or related field.
  • Experience operating major RDBMS (Oracle, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL).
  • Strong SQL skills and performance tuning experience.
  • Knowledge of backup/recovery processes and HA configurations.
  • Experience with Linux-based server environments.
  • Experience handling databases in financial or high-transaction environments.


Job Descriptions:

  • Operate and manage core trading and business-critical databases.
  • Monitor database performance and conduct query/index tuning.
  • Establish backup and recovery policies and support DR operations.
  • Perform capacity planning and database architecture design.
  • Manage DB accounts, access control, and security policies.
  • Support database modeling and structure design for new development projects.
  • Analyze incidents and implement preventive measures.
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulatory requirements and internal audit standards.


Preferred:

  • Experience as a DBA in the securities or financial industry.
  • Experience with Oracle RAC and Data Guard.
  • Experience with MPP or NoSQL databases (Redis, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Experience with DB automation in a DevOps environment.
  • Experience in troubleshooting and performance improvement projects.
  • Relevant certifications (OCP, SQLD/SQLP, etc.).


Work Arrangement: Full Work From Office (WFO) at our Jakarta HQ.

Candidates are expected to perform duties on-site to ensure effective coordination and alignment with our business operations.

Our commitment is to continuously evolve, delivering value-added services that anticipate and adapt to the changing needs of our clients in capital market industry.


  • Join us to be part of a team where your professional journey is enriched by shared values and a dedication to excellence.

descriptionHtml:
Role Description

  • Design the experiences, visuals, and voices of Finku’s mobile app & websites
  • Ensure an appealing visual and usable experience within the product.
  • Conduct experiments to identify the ideal experiences that resonate best with users.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers to implement your designs into working mobile apps.
  • Maintain close contact with our users to identify their needs and pain points.

Role Requirements

  • Experience in creating digital product designs (experience in marketing designs is a plus!), with a minimum of 2 years of full-time working experience.
  • Ability to create appealing visuals and ensure a usable experience within the product.
  • Comfortable dealing with abstract problems and data, and adept at turning them into tangible solutions.
  • Understanding of local Indonesian context and the financial pain-points faced.
  • Comfortable with speaking and writing in casual English.
  • Most importantly, must be willing to learn.
  • Bonus: Comfortable with creating digital product copywriting.
